articleTitle: Analyzing and Detecting Digital Counterfeit Images using DenseNet, ResNet and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study utilizes DenseNet architecture to detect copy-move forgeries in digital images. DenseNet’s architecture is utilized for efficient feature extraction, leveraging its dense connections to facilitate improved feature learning. Initial preprocessing tasks are performed to prepare the images, followed by patch extraction and feature extraction using DenseNet. Additionally, a ResNet model is trained on a dataset containing authentic and manipulated images, which is then utilized to identify forgeries in unseen images. Further enhancements in results can be achieved through post-processing techniques. The primary goal of this research is to enhance the precision and reliability of copy-move forgery detection in digital images. This objective is pursued by developing and implementing a DenseNet-based methodology for feature extraction and learning. By leveraging the inherent strengths of DenseNet architecture, the system aims to achieve higher performance levels in detecting copy-move forgeries compared to traditional methodologies. The ultimate aim is to drive progress in the field of image forensics and strengthen the integrity of digital visual content across various domains.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Prediction and Management using AI (Artificial Intelligence), ML (Machine Learning) and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Forest fires pose significant threats to public safety and the environment, releasing hazardous pollutants and spreading rapidly through vegetated areas. Early detection is critical to prevent forest fires from becoming catastrophic, but the dynamic nature of weather conditions complicates this process. This study addresses the challenge by employing advanced Deep Learning (DL) techniques, utilizing algorithms such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Logistic Regression, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to analyze images captured by satellites, drones, and webcams. Developing a neural model involves constructing, training, and fine-tuning sophisticated algorithms, optimizing accuracy by adjusting parameters such as dense layers and hidden layers. Data preprocessing techniques, including data augmentation, are used to enhance the input and improve model performance. The integration of new technologies and approaches, such as deep learning and data augmentation, aims to mitigate the effects of wildfires and protect both human lives and the environment. The ultimate goal of this research study is to enhance early detection systems and reduce response times, thereby minimizing the detrimental impact of forest fires on ecosystems and communities.

articleTitle: Blynk-Powered IoT System with Machine Learning for Personalized Plant Care
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research explores the development of a prototype Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled smart irrigation system and investigates its potential integration with machine learning (ML). The primary mechanism, constructed using Blynk, facilitates real-time sensor data monitoring (temperature, humidity, and moisture) and enables manual irrigation control via a mobile application. The secondary mechanism includes the integration of Machine Learning (ML) model, facilitating data-driven predictions for optimal watering schedules. This ML integrated IoT system has the potential to revolutionize irrigation practices, promoting water conservation and potentially enhancing plant health through precise watering based on real-time sensor data and historical trends.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: An enormous challenge for both financial institutions and consumers as a result of the exponential expansion in digital transactions and the related increase in credit card fraud incidences. As fraudulent actions get more complicated, traditional ways of detecting fraud are becoming less and less effective. Utilizing cutting-edge analytical methods is therefore imperative in order to safeguard financial assets and maintain public confidence in the banking system. To examine transaction data from credit card networks and financial institutions, we use machine learning methods in this study. In particular, we apply sentiment analysis to identify possible credit card fraud using the Random Forest, Logistic Regression, and Naive Bayes algorithms. These algorithms were selected because they work well with big datasets and can identify trends that point to fraudulent activity. When accuracy is used to evaluate algorithm performance, Naïve Bayes comes out on top, with an impressive accuracy percentage of 99.30% among the algorithms examined. Nonetheless, the Random Forest and Logistic Regression algorithms also perform admirably, with accuracy rates of 98.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Skin Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: With skin cancer rates increasing, it remains a significant public health issue. Early detection is crucial for successful treatment. Despite recent strides in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications for skin lesion classification, these methods often grapple with accuracy limitations. Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as a promising area for improving the classification accuracy. This study introduces a novel approach leveraging fine-tuning techniques applied to the Xception pretrained model specifically tailored for skin lesion classification. By augmenting the HAM10000 dataset, which comprises diverse lesions across seven classes, and incorporating advanced augmentation strategies, this study aims to mitigate data imbalance effects and enhance the robustness of the proposed model. Furthermore, this study conducts a thorough comparative analysis, benchmarking the proposed approach against state-of-the-art methods to evaluate its efficacy and reliability. The research findings indicate that the proposed fine-tuned Xception model exhibits superior efficiency and reliability compared to previous models, achieving an impressive accuracy of 96%. The augmentation approach, combined with fine-tuning, enables the proposed model to achieve enhanced classification accuracy. The proposed approach shows the potential in enabling precise and timely skin lesion diagnosis, enhancing patient outcomes and advancing AI-driven healthcare.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence (AI) based on Real Time Patient Monitoring System in Intensive Care Unit and its Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the intensive care unit (ICU), patients receive continuous life-support treatment facilitated by advanced medical technologies. Mechanical ventilators assist with breathing, intravenous fluids regulate bloodstream hydration, and body-attached sensors monitor vital signs such as heart rate and blood pressure. Bedside monitors visualize this data, ensuring that patient care aligns with medical objectives. Establishing an efficient monitoring process in the ICU involves several stages to ensure effective oversight and performance evaluation of tasks, initiatives, and systems. This research study provides a comprehensive analysis for developing and implementing a robust monitoring process in ICU settings, aimed at optimizing patient care and treatment outcomes.

articleTitle: Arduino based GPS Guided Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Autonomous driving cars are major applications in many fields. This project focuses on building an Arduino based car capable of autonomous navigation to a specific location using a Global Positioning System (GPS) module and a digital compass for delivering a package to the destined location. The integration of digital compass helps guide the vehicle to reach the destination. The vehicle can travel towards the set location (destinations) either by taking inputs in the form of longitude and latitude or by using a sequence of relative moments. The motor driver module helps control the speed and direction of the Direct Current (DC) motors and the Arduino adjusts the motor speed based on compass heading errors to ensure precise and affirmative navigation towards the location. The ejection system shall deliver out the package as soon as it reaches the destination.

articleTitle: Package Delivery Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study focuses on the development and implementation of an advanced package delivery robot managed and controlled by an ATmega328P microcontroller. The robot autonomously picks up packages from designated pickup points and delivers them to their intended destinations within hotel premises. Controlled by hotel staff, the robot’s locomotion and manipulation capabilities are facilitated by servo motors connected to the ATmega328P microcontroller. Additionally, the robot’s movement is regulated by gear motors, which are managed by an L298D motor driver also linked to the microcontroller. Wireless communication between the robot and users is facilitated through a Bluetooth module (HC-05) connected to the microcontroller. In cases where the robot encounters difficulties navigating its environment, a buzzer integrated into the microcontroller emits warning signals to alert nearby individuals. Upon successfully reaching its destination, the robot sends a notification message to the user’s mobile phone via a messaging app controlled by hotel staff. Throughout its journey, the robot’s movements and surroundings are monitored in real-time using a Wi-Fi camera integrated into its design. This innovative package delivery robot offers a hands-free, contactless, and hygienic solution for delivering packages to customers, thereby enhancing user experience and consumer satisfaction within the hospitality sector.

articleTitle: Design of Drowning Rescue Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Drowning is a critical worldwide general wellbeing concern with thousands of lives lost annually due to water-related accidents. Despite efforts to promote water safety, the lack of an effective and widely accessible anti-drowning system remains a critical issue. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of anti-drowning measures and explores the critical role of educational programs in imparting water safety skills, particularly among vulnerable population such as children and non-swimmers. The proposed system uses sensors like SPO2 and MPU-6050 to comprehensively monitor and detect drowning incidents by analyzing oxygen saturation levels and underwater movements. This study enhances the capability to accurately determine and display the depth at which swimmer is located, aiding rescuers in assessing the severity of the drowning situation and planning targeted rescue strategies. Power supply optimization is a key challenge addressed in research, with a focus on energy-efficient designs and advanced battery technologies to ensure sustained operation in aquatic environments. The implemented system gives clear and real-time display of drowning parameters on both the receiver’s LCD and mobile devices to enhance communication and coordination, ensuring effective monitoring and response to potential drowning incidents.

articleTitle: Advances in Machine Learning for Alzheimer’s disease Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Overview and Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This paper comprehensively analyses recent advances in machine learning methods for early Alzheimer’s disease (AD) diagnosis. It underscores the transformative impact of machine learning in healthcare, improving patient-doctor relationships and personalized treatment recommendations. Deep neural networks, graph-based deep learning, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have shown promise in accurately identifying AD stages, with classification accuracy ranging from 90% to 97%. Despite improvements, challenges like class imbalance, biomarker selection, and missing feature data persist. Recent advancements like federated learning enable collaborative forecasting across healthcare facilities while ensuring data confidentiality and consistency. This synthesis contributes to understanding the development of machine learning techniques for early AD diagnosis, with implications for clinical practice and future research combating neurodegenerative diseases.

articleTitle: Development of Helical Type Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The helical-type Savonius wind turbine is a form of vertical-axis wind turbine (VAWT) that has helical or S- shaped blades instead of the conventional straight-blade Savonius design. This special design was created to overcome some of the drawbacks of Savonius turbines with straight blades. A possible choice for areas with low wind speeds, the helical design of the blades provides for increased performance characteristics, including a self-starting capability. The turbine can function well even in windy conditions thanks to the helical blades’ ability to capture wind from different directions. Due to its adaptability in wind collection and self-starting capability, it is a desirable option for distributed energy generation in both urban and rural settings. A vertical-axis wind turbine with S -shaped blades that resemble a helix is known as a helical-type Savonius wind turbine. Comparing this innovative design to conventional straight-blade Savonius turbines, there are certain benefits and difficulties. The helical blades are appropriate for areas with low wind speeds since they can capture wind from different directions and can start on their own. Comparing them to other wind turbine designs, they might, nevertheless, produce less power and have a lower efficiency. A growing number of renewable energy sources are being sought after as a result of the need to combat climate change and lessen reliance on fossil fuels. Wind power is one of the most prominent renewable energy sources in the world and plays a significant role in the energy mix. Helical wind turbines are becoming more and more popular in the field of wind energy due to their distinctive design, which may provide benefits above conventional horizontal- and vertical-axis turbines.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Diabetes Prediction: Comparative Analysis and Pre-processing Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study investigates the predictive capabilities of seven machine learning algorithms in the domain of diabetes prediction, revealing that the Support Vector Classifier (SVC) attained the highest accuracy of 0.793, closely followed by Logistic Regression with 0.787. Accuracy scores for Decision Tree, Random Forest, AdaBoost, and Gradient Boosting classifiers ranged from 0.727 to 0.78, while the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model achieved an accuracy of 0.7. Notably, the SVM approach exhibited superior performance, particularly with a radial basis kernel function. Comprehensive dataset preparation, addressing issues such as missing values and varying class difficulties, was undertaken, with subsequent partitioning into training and testing sets via holdout validation. Various classification algorithms, including logistic regression, decision trees, K-nearest neighbor, and support vector machines, were employed. This research study highlights the importance of data preprocessing and the significant role of machine learning methods in improving the accuracy of diabetes prediction

articleTitle: A study on Anomaly-based Intrusion Detection Systems Employing Supervised Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The rise of smart cities, driverless automobiles, smart watches, and mobile banking has led to increased reliance on the Internet. Although technology has enormous advantages for people and society, it also introduces threats. Cyber attacks are more common in this digital world and the intruders are working hard to enter into the business websites or an organization data server. Hence, integrating an intrusion detection system (IDS) is essential in the security environment because it enables IT infrastructure to resist threats. Conventional IDS are limited to detect only sophisticated attacks and fails to detect the hidden and other anomalies that occur in the network Systems. An accurate and strong approach for IDS must be created to solve this difficulty for the successful functioning of businesses. The present study explores the use of supervised Deep Learning (DL) techniques and recommends an effective model for anomaly detection. The performance evaluation of the model is performed using NSL-KDD dataset and KDDcup99 and the explored DL models in this study are compared in terms of accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection System using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the face of increasing cyber threats and the expansion of computer connections and applications, strong protection against cyber-attacks has become necessary. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are necessary to detect anomalies and dangers in computer networks and thus increase network security. This research combines machine learning (ML) with artificial intelligence (AI) to inform data-driven access to research. Before using the particle separator, the particle s warm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to reduce residue. The popular KDD-CUP 99 database was used to evaluate the performance of various methods, including parameters such as the ability to detect network interference. Before using the particle separator, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to reduce residue. Using the popular KDD-CUP 99 database, the performance of this method is evaluated based on metrics such as s pecificity, recall, f1 score, precision, accuracy, and consistency across many types of cyberattacks. The results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed strategy to improve network security by accurately identifying and reducing network crimes.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Rice Blast Disease Utilizing Ensemble Voting Classifiers in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Rice is the second-most significant cereal plant, next to wheat, and the most commonly cultivated staple food in India. Rice production has declined in recent years due to the spread of several rice diseases, changes in weather conditions, and soil quality. Rice blast, also known as RB, is the most devastating of all rice plant diseases and causes a vast amount of annual loss. The key challenge is to minimize crop loss due to rice blast disease while also increasing agricultural output. It is critical to predict the disease ahead of time so that the required safeguards can be taken. As manual prediction of rice blast disease requires a huge amount of labor and time, it is a must to implement an automated system using machine learning (ML) techniques, which are widely used artificial intelligence (AI) methods for prediction models. In the proposed system, the sample data set of 15,400 has been fed as an input to the ML algorithms via Nïve Bayes, random forest, KNN, and voting classifiers for prediction. The results show that the ensemble method of combining the machine learning algorithm-based prediction technique offers improved accuracy than the random forest algorithm, with an accuracy of 99.5%. The proposed methodology will greatly benefit agriculturalists with increased profits and safeguard food for the country.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis for Advancements in Brain Tumor Detection Model by using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Brain tumors pose a significant threat due to their uncontrolled cell proliferation, necessitating timely and precise treatment. Despite notable advancements, accurate segmentation and classification of brain tumors remain challenging, given the complexity of tumor characteristics such as location, shape, and size. This research study explores into the complexities of brain tumor detection using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), including discussions on tumor shape analysis, data repositories, image enhancement techniques, segmentation methodologies, feature extraction, and classification algorithms. Furthermore, this study explores the emerging field of Machine Learning (ML), including deep learning, transfer learning, and quantum machine learning, within the field of brain tumor research. By considering relevant scholarly works, this research study interprets the benefits, limitations, recent advancements, and potential opportunities for brain tumor detection. Achieving sufficient tumor segmentation accuracy, reducing false positives, and accurately categorizing tumors into benign and malignant classes holds the potential to improve patient care and treatment outcomes.

articleTitle: A Review on Crop Yield Prediction using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The integration of cutting-edge technology into agricultural practices has catalyzed a transformative shift in global agriculture. This research study focuses on the revolutionary impact of deep learning approaches on crop yield prediction, a critical aspect of sustainable agriculture amid increasing global food demands. Traditional methods for crop yield estimation are examined initially, revealing limitations in accuracy and adaptability to diverse agroclimatic conditions. Subsequently, the rise of deep learning is explored, highlighting its ability to autonomously extract complex patterns from vast agricultural datasets. This research study provides a comprehensive classification and analysis of deep learning architectures, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and attention mechanisms, in the context of agricultural yield prediction. This study discusses about the incorporation of sensor-based information, satellite imagery, and climate data into deep learning models, emphasizing the synergy among the data sources to enhance the prediction accuracy. Additionally, this research study addresses the challenges related to data quality, model interpretability, and scalability, proposing solutions and future research directions. By illuminating the transformative role of deep learning in crop yield prediction, this research study equips researchers, practitioners, and policymakers with valuable insights to advance sustainable agriculture and ensure global food security amidst changing climatic patterns and demographic trends.

articleTitle: Prediction of Car Sales Price Trends using Ensembling Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Predicting car prices accurately is crucial for both consumers and sellers in the automotive industry. This paper delves into the utilization of machine learning methods for forecasting car prices By analyzing sales, price datas and various factors influencing sales, brand of the car, type of the fuel, mileage, Price it covers We construct predictive frameworks employing machine learning algorithms and ensemble learning algorithms like Gradient boosting, Catboost, Voting Regressor, Bagging Regression, Ridge Regression Through feature engineering, we extract relevant information to improve the accuracy of our predictions and novelty between the algorithms to get more ac-curated results. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in providing valuable insights for car manufacturers and dealerships to optimize their strategies and operations. This helps businesses make informed decisions and stay competitive in the market. This research study contributes to the growing body of knowledge with the integration of Machine Learning (ML) analytics. By evaluating the performance of various predictive models and identifying the key factors influencing car sales, this study intends to provide useful suggestions for both industry professionals and researchers, encouraging innovation and effectiveness in the automotive field.

articleTitle: Product Price Prediction Using Ensemble Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study explores the various methods for predicting product prices utilizing past information on attributes, sales trends, and market trends. The suggested methodology may identify patterns and generate accurate price forecasts for new products by examining big datasets that include details about pricing trends, consumer behavior, and comparable products. The objective is to develop a precise system that can predict prices accurately even when the market changes. This will assist businesses in determining fair prices so they may increase revenue and satisfy clients. Many industries stand to gain from the research since it will enable them to use technology to make more informed pricing decisions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection Systems in IoT Networks: A Hybrid Approach using CNN, ANN, LSTM, GRU for Improved Security
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The automation of daily tasks via the Internet of Things (IoT) has drastically changed people’s lives in the last few years. By connecting different physical devices with various functionalities, this is accomplished. As a result, as IoT networks grow, so does the rate of cyber threats, risking the stability and integrity of data. Numerous intrusion detection systems (IDS s) are currently developed to identify harmful actions based on predefined attacks patterns, thereby safeguarding data against misuse and abnormal attempts. The current IDS have to be improved due to the sharp rise in these types of attacks. The key to enhancing intrusion detection systems is now machining learning. A proposed intrusion detection methodology in this study is hybrid approach. After evaluating the model’s performance using a number of popular, advanced methods currently in use, the suggested model uses CNN, ANN, LSTM and GRU model. The model gives better trade -off compared to other approaches.

articleTitle: Crop Prediction to Aid Farmers using Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study used Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to predict the suitable crop by inputting the potassium, nitrogen, phosphorous ratios, humidity, rainfall, and soil type. The data are collected, preprocessed, and then trained using algorithms with good accuracy. Some algorithms are used, like decision trees, random forests, support vector machines, and neural networks. To get more accuracy using the performance evaluation with this best-accurate algorithm, the crop that is best suited is predicted. This will help the agriculture department and final users get the cultivation done in an efficient way, and people can do this type of work and select the crop based on the yields. It can lead to the improvement of agriculture in the country. It will be passed on to the next generation and help those who are going to do the agriculture research.

articleTitle: Advancements in Text-To-Image Synthesis: A Comprehensive Review of Techniques, Challenges, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Recent advancements in text-to-image synthesis are explored through innovative approaches designed to address key challenges in generating realistic images from textual descriptions. These approaches include IIR-Net, CRD-CGAN, GALIP, Transformer-based methods, StyleGAN-T, and OPGAN. Each model introduces distinct techniques such as Image Information Removal (IIR), attention mechanisms, CLIP integration, and object-centric architectures, aiming to enhance fidelity, diversity, semantic consistency, and object modelling accuracy. Evaluation across diverse datasets demonstrates their superior performance over existing methods, highlighting improvements in editability, photorealism, and control over the synthesis process. Further-more, future research directions are discussed, emphasizing the need for refining text alignment, advancing object modelling techniques, and exploring personalized GAN approaches to further advance text-to-image synthesis.

articleTitle: Cyber Sentinel: Intelligent Phishing URL Identification System Employing Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Phishing attacks are a continuous threat to internet users, with the potential to cause identity theft, money losses, and other security lapses. The key to successfully preventing these threats is the automated detection of phishing URLs. This study presents a novel approach to detect phishing URLs that makes use of a range of Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Based on their inherent characteristics, the performance of multiple algorithms is assessed in between phishing and authentic URLs. K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machine, Random Forests, XGBoost, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, and Multilayer Perceptron have been used. Using the suggested method, characteristics are taken from URLs, including lexical, domain-based, and content-based features including length of the URL, age of the domain, suspicious keyword presence, and resemblance to well-known phishing URLs. The impact of every algorithm’s is analyzed utilizing parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score on an extensive dataset that includes a sizable number of both phishing and genuine URLs. The proposed tests demonstrating the fact that XGBoost model has an impressive 97% accuracy rate in identifying phishing URLs, demonstrating the potency of the suggested strategy. Furthermore, the utilization methods for the use of Machine Learning in the in the real world to improve global cybersecurity measures by being integrated into web browsers, email filters, and network security solutions is discussed.

articleTitle: Analyzing Student Performance for Early Intervention: A Binary Classification Study
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study investigates the classification of pass/fail outcomes of students without using the G3 characteristics, which stands for final grades. The dataset includes a variety of characteristics, including the socioeconomic variables. This study intends to create reliable machine-learning models to predict student outcomes based on certain characteristics. This will help to get important insights into early intervention techniques and enable support systems in educational environments. The proposed supervised learning method involves training and evaluating ensemble models of multiple classification algorithms through the application of cross-validation techniques. The outcomes show that the proposed method produces good classification accuracy rates, proving that the machine learning techniques are effective in forecasting student success irrespective of final grades. The study’s insights can help educational stakeholders to support atrisk students and raise overall academic attainment.

articleTitle: Strategic Load Balancing: Game Theory Approach for Optimized Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the field of computing, the importance of efficient load distribution across multiple server environments has become paramount, especially in the context of ensuring high availability and reliability of web services. This study intends to explore the challenges involved in load balancing technology, a critical component used in scaling applications and services across various computing resources. By evenly distributing workloads, load balancers optimize resource utilization, maximize throughput, minimize response time, and avoid overload of any single resource. This study reviews various algorithms and methodologies employed in load balancing, including round-robin, least connections, and IP hash techniques. Furthermore, this study also examines the evolution of load balancing solutions from traditional onpremise appliances to modern cloud-based services, highlighting the shift towards more flexible, scalable, and costefficient models. Through a comprehensive analysis of existing literature and case studies, this study highlights the pivotal role of load balancers in enhancing the performance and reliability of web services, while also addressing the challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field.

articleTitle: Cloud-Powered Mobility: A Seamless Integration Approach for Mobile Apps
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: As cloud services continue to gain importance, their integration with mobile applications lags, despite notable exceptions such as Telegram. This research study analyzes the foundational aspects of cloud computing systems, their organization, architecture, and the need for mobile application integration. It explains the necessary development tools and motivations driving app migration to the cloud, while also exploring the fundamentals and layers of mobile cloud computing systems. Through an analysis of techniques like data synchronization and computational offloading, this study highlights the importance of security and reliability. Case studies across domains demonstrate the scalability of this framework for next-generation mobile applications. Furthermore, security and privacy concerns are addressed, alongside an exploration of the services offered by mobile-based cloud providers. Highlighting measures for ensuring security, privacy, and reliability in cloud-powered mobility solutions, this research study covers fault tolerance, data encryption, and authentication systems. Integration with major cloud providers like Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform is discussed, along with advanced methodologies and recommendations for future advancements in the field.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Models for Cyber Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has made Cyber Physical Systems (CPS) more secure. This has created unique security challenges as the traditional security solutions are meant for general IT or OT systems, which do not perform well in a CPS enabled environment. With an emphasis on Industrial Control Systems (ICS), this research study offers a thorough two-level ensemble attack detection and attribution system designed especially for Cyber Physical Systems (CPS). An ensemble deep learning model, which is especially good at identifying attacks in unbalanced Industrial Control Systems (ICS) environments, is combined with a decision tree at the first level. Moving on to the next stage, an ensemble deep neural network is designed to deliver accurate attack attribution. Real-time datasets are used to confirm that the proposed model works as intended. The results show better performance than other approaches with comparable computational complexity.

articleTitle: Career Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study uses advanced machine learning techniques to predict students’ career paths more accurately. By analyzing and preprocessing various data, including academic performance, extracurricular activities, internships, and personality traits, the study identifies patterns. Ethical considerations, privacy protection, and bias prevention are part of the model development process. The practical applications include personalized career counseling, improving curricula, and optimizing alumni networks. Despite challenges like model interpret ability and adapting to changing job markets, interdisciplinary collaboration is crucial. Overall, educational institutions can use these techniques to provide customized support, helping students make informed career decisions in today’s ever-changing workforce.

articleTitle: Analysis of Advanced Technology Integrated Interviews
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study explores the integration of video facial expression analysis with audio-to-text conversion technologies to enhance communication skills assessment in mock interviews. By combining these technologies, the proposed system aims to provide a comprehensive and objective evaluation of a candidate’s verbal and non-verbal communication abilities. The proposed model utilizes advanced Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, including Deep Learning (DL) models for facial expression recognition and Natural Language Processing (NLP) for speech analysis. The proposed system promises to revolutionize the traditional approach to interview training and preparation by providing detailed feedback that candidates can use to improve their communication skills effectively.

articleTitle: Smart Dust Removal System for Solar Panel by using Programmable Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The increasing reliance on solar power systems as a sustainable and renewable energy source necessitates maintaining optimal performance, which can be hindered by dust and debris accumulation on solar panels. This research study explores the development and implementation of a Solar Panel Cleaning System by using Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) technology. The study focuses on the design, construction, and integration of an automated cleaning mechanism controlled by a PLC, aimed at enhancing the efficiency of solar panels. Employing sensors to trigger the PLC, the proposed system initiates a cleaning process using mechanical tools like brushes or wipers combined with water cleaning agents, ensuring effective dirt removal without damaging the panels. This research study highlights the significance of PLC-based automation in improving solar PV system performance and offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly solution to mitigate efficiency losses due to dirt accumulation. The findings hold particular relevance for regions like India, where energy shortages are prevalent, highlighting the crucial role of renewable energy sources in meeting the country’s energy demands and enhancing overall energy security. The drawbacks of the current solar panel cleaning technologies, including their inefficiency, the dangers associated with manual labour, and their uneven cleaning performance. A brief discussion of recent methods will be given, highlighting their drawbacks before moving on to the suggested goal. The integrated PLC in the proposed solar panel cleaning system automates the maintenance procedure to guarantee optimal performance from the solar panels. The inputs from different sensors that track the state of the cleaning mechanism and the surrounding environment are crucial to the operation of the system. The solar panel surfaces are regularly monitored for cleanliness by a dust sensor.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diabetes Prognostication: Precision Forecasting via Ensemble Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The metabolic illness known as diabetes is categorized by raised blood sugar points, which may lead to symptoms such as polyuria, polydipsia, and polyphagia. Diabetes is more common than other metabolic disorders. If unmanaged, it can result in severe acute and long-term complications. In order to anticipate the probability of diabetes-related complications, this research investigates the use of ensemble learning techniques such as XGBoost, AdaBoost, and Bagging. The objective is to enhance predictive accuracy using commonly available laboratory results. Performance metrics, including recall, accuracy, precision, and F1 score, were used to assess the models. The results indicate that AdaBoost outperforms the other models, achieving the highest accuracy of $\mathrm{94.6\%}$, precision of $\mathrm{93.2\%}$, recall 92.1%, and F 1 score of 92.6%. XGBoost also demonstrates strong performance with 94.3% accuracy, $\mathrm{93.1\%}$ precision, $\mathrm{90.1\%}$ recall, and $\mathrm{91.5\%}$ F1 score. Bagging, while effective, shows relatively lower performance metrics. The high predictive capability of the proposed models, particularly AdaBoost, highlights their potential for integration into online tools to assist physicians in predicting future diabetes risk and implementing preventive interventions. AdaBoost, with its balanced and superior performance, is recommended for applications where high classification accuracy is essential, while XGBoost remains a strong alternative. Bagging may be preferred in scenarios prioritizing model simplicity and interpretability.

articleTitle: Automated tiered Detection of Cyber-Attacks in Operational Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The increasing dependence on digital technologies within power grids brings forth a pressing concern: the vulnerability to cyber-attacks poses a significant threat to its security and reliability. In response, this research proposes an innovative approach leveraging ensemble learning techniques to predict and mitigate cyber-attacks in Smart Grids. By combining the strengths of diverse models such as Extra Trees, XGBoost, Random Forest, and Bagging, the ensemble model aims to bolster attack detection accuracy and robustness. Through real-time monitoring, anomaly detection, and rapid response mechanisms, the framework enhances the resilience of Smart Grids against evolving cyber threats. The research focuses on refining a predictive model capable of distinguishing legitimate data from malicious injections, thus ensuring the ongoing security and reliability of critical energy infrastructure. This innovative ensemble learning approach represents a promising strategy to fortify modern power grids, safeguarding against sophisticated cyber threats and ensuring continued operational integrity.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Food Identification and Waste Reduction Solution with Built-in Nutritional Tracking using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Food Solutions and Nutrition Checker is an innovative and comprehensive project aimed at providing users with a reliable tool to identify various foods and dishes, while also offering a custom-built database for detecting fresh and wasted food items. With this system, users can easily determine the nutritional value of different foods, making informed decisions about their dietary choices. This study incorporates advanced technology that enables the recognition of a wide range of food items. By simply capturing an image or specifying the dish, users can obtain accurate information about the food, including its ingredients and origin. This feature is particularly helpful for individuals with specific dietary needs or restrictions, allowing them to easily identify suitable menu options. Additionally, this study includes a custom-built data system that helps to identify fresh and wasted food. By analyzing factors such as expiration dates, storage conditions, and quality indicators, the proposed system can determine the freshness status of various food items. This capability promotes food waste reduction by enabling users to make informed decisions regarding the consumption or disposal of perishable goods. Moreover, this study incorporates a nutritional tracker that provides users with comprehensive information regarding the nutritional composition of different foods. This feature includes details such as calorie count, macronutrient breakdown, vitamins, and minerals, empowering users to make healthier food choices aligned with their dietary goals and requirements. Overall, the proposed model offers a holistic approach for food identification, waste reduction, and nutritional tracking. By incorporating advanced technology and a robust database, this study aims to facilitate informed decision-making and promote healthier dietary practices.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Emotional Responses and Emerging Patterns on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Social media sites especially Twitter have emerged as a well-known public platform for receiving information on public perspectives and trends following big incidents. This research investigates Twitter data acquired during the Syrian and Turkish earthquake crises. To collect insights from public comments and associated topics, the proposed method comprises data processing, mood analysis, and trend detection. A multitude of visuals, including word clouds, emotion distributions, and source studies, are applied to analyze critical facts and patterns. The advantages of connecting social media data for emotion analysis and real-time event monitoring are investigated in this research study.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accident Prediction Through Integrated KNN and DBSCAN Algorithms for Superior Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Accurate accident severity prediction is essential for a successful emergency response and traffic management. This study addresses this problem by proposing a methodology that integrates the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithms. Initially, a dataset is pre-processed by applying label encoding for performing algorithmic analysis. The KNN algorithm identifies patterns and similarities in the data, while DBSCAN performs well in detecting clusters and outliers, enriching the understanding of accident severity. The accuracies of both algorithms are systematically compared, revealing details about their individual strengths and limitations. To enhance accuracy, an ensemble learning strategy combines KNN and DBSCAN into a hybrid model. The evaluation demonstrates the hybrid model’s superiority over individual algorithms, showcasing a substantial improvement in accuracy. The study identifies the highest positive correlation among variables, crucial for understanding the factors influencing accident severity. The decision to integrate KNN and DBSCAN is justified by their complementary features, contributing to a more comprehensive and accurate predictive model. The exclusion of KNN and OPTICS is backed by observed lesser accuracy in the combined model, emphasizing the importance of algorithm selection based on individual merits and compatibility within an ensemble framework. In conclusion, this research advances accident prediction methodologies, presenting a unique and effective approach to enhancing accuracy in assessing accident severity.

articleTitle: Greenguard: CNN-based system for Intelligent Plant Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Plant diseases significantly impact agricultural output, yet traditional detection methods are costly, time-consuming, and inaccurate. This study proposes a more efficient disease recognition model based on image processing and deep learning, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). These networks perform well at analyzing leaf images to identify plant diseases. However, existing models trained on ideal conditions struggle with real-world field photos featuring complex backgrounds and multiple leaves. To address this challenge, the study will test and compare various CNN architectures like VGG19, AlexNet, and ResNet aiming to find the model with the highest accuracy in detecting diseases under realistic conditions. The ultimate goal is to develop a tool that empowers farmers to quickly and accurately identify crop diseases, ultimately leading to improved agricultural output and reduced losses.

articleTitle: Hypokinetic Rigid Syndrome: Early Prediction of Parkinson’s Disease using Ensemble classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative illness that manifests as both motor and non-motor symptoms. About 90% of patients experience early onset speech problems. This paper proposes a machine learning system to help with early diagnosis and maybe impede the progression of disease by using ensemble classifiers on speech feature datasets from the UCI repository. There are three instances of speech characteristics in each of the numerous feature subsets from 252 participants that make up the dataset. Highly correlated features are integrated using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminate Analysis (LDA) in order to preserve information integrity. Ensemble classifiers such as bagging, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XgBoost), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), and Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost) are used for PD prediction. Through the use of methods like grid search and random search, hyperparameter tuning is used to maximize model performance. Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 score, and Support are some of the evaluation metrics. The experimental results show that boosting classifiers achieve more accuracy than bagging classifiers, grid search improves outcomes over random search, and PCA outperforms LDA.

articleTitle: Assessing Water Dissolved Oxygen Dynamics: Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Approach for Environmental Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Water is very important natural resource for the human beings, animals etc. The quality of water depends on multiple factors so it is vital for us to maintain the quality of water so that we can balance environmental well-being, public health. The study analyzes the association between water quality variables (TH, turbidity, TDS) and dissolved oxygen (DO) in Naini Lake, Nainital, using an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model to forecast short-term correlation and predict long-term co-integration and uncertainty changes. The study finds TDS positively impacts DO in short and long terms, Turbidity negatively affects DO long-term, and TH has no significant impact. These findings inform environmental policies on water pollution’s effects on DO levels.

articleTitle: Smart Security Management using IoT and HC-05 Bluetooth Module
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Safety and security are essential for every individual worldwide, particularly in the context of home security. Modern advancements in science and technology have introduced various innovative solutions, including smart security locking mechanisms. This research study presents a novel smart lock system that leverages mobile phone applications integrated with built-in fingerprint authentication. Unlike other smart locks that rely on external biometric devices, this system utilizes the smartphone’s internal fingerprint sensor, thereby reducing hardware costs and complexity. Additionally, the application supports multiple authentication methods, such as fingerprint and facial recognition, enhancing security and convenience. This solution eliminates the risk of key loss and ensures that only authenticated users can access the home. The lock mechanism operates automatically, allowing the door to open and close without human intervention, providing a seamless and secure user experience.

articleTitle: Creation of a Solar-Powered, Multifunctional, Autonomous Agricultural Robot for Sustainable Farming Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study introduces a Solar Powered Autonomous Multipurpose Agriculture Robot, designed to revolutionize sustainable farming practices. Harnessing solar energy for power, integrated with advanced autonomous control systems, the robot autonomously executes various agricultural tasks. Its versatility extends to crop monitoring, irrigation, and pest control, promising enhanced efficiency and reduced environmental impact. Through renewable energy utilization and autonomous functionality, this innovative solution addresses the imperative for eco-friendly agricultural practices, paving way for increased productivity and environmental stewardship. The transition towards sustainable farming methods necessitates the development of innovative agricultural technologies. Recent advancements in precision farming, autonomous agricultural vehicles, and renewable energy integration have demonstrated considerable potential in enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability. Despite these advancements, several challenges hinder the widespread adoption and effectiveness of these systems. High implementation costs, energy management complexities, limited operational autonomy, and the intricate integration of diverse technologies into a unified system are significant obstacles. The proposed project seeks to overcome these challenges by developing a solarpowered, multifunctional, autonomous agricultural robot. The primary objective is to create a cost-effective, efficient, and autonomous solution that can operate independently in various agricultural environments, thereby promoting sustainable farming practices and reducing reliance on non-renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Securing the Cloud: A Comprehensive Analysis of Emerging Threats and Defense Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study analyzes the cloud computing security, addressing vulnerabilities inherited from SOA and virtualization. Within the SPI model, this study proposes countermeasures and reviews solutions from prominent suppliers, alongside insights into the challenges impeding mainstream adoption. This study examines proprietary and open-source cloud alternatives to aid IT decision-makers in making informed choices. It emphasizes standardized Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and utilizes uniform security standards to enhance cloud security. The conclusions drawn from this investigation enhance cloud security, which is essential for encouraging wider adoption.

articleTitle: Smart Irrigation System using ESP8266, NodeMCU & ThingSpeak
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents the Smart Irrigation System using ESP8266 NODEMCU and ThingSpeak as there is an increasing need to integrate new technologies such as IoT, cloud computing, and advanced sensing technologies to address the challenges faced by modern irrigation systems and sustainable agriculture practices. This study utilizes a ThingSpeak platform and ESP8266 microcontroller-based Smart Irrigation System (SIS). The proposed system incorporates real-time data monitoring and control methods with the goal of optimizing water usage in agriculture. The proposed system is a low-cost Wi-Fi module called ESP8266, which allows wireless communication between sensors, actuators, and the cloud-based ThingSpeak platform. Sensors placed across the agricultural field are used to monitor a variety of environmental characteristics, including temperature, humidity, and soil moisture. After that, the gathered data is sent to ThingSpeak, where it is processed and examined to determine the appropriate amount of irrigation.

articleTitle: Real Time Stock Inventory Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: For companies looking to stay competitive in the dynamic and fast-paced business world of today, effective stock inventory management has become critical. In order to provide organizations with an all-inclusive and flexible inventory control solution, this paper presents a Real-Time Stock Inventory Management System. The system provides real-time stock inventory tracking, monitoring, and management by utilizing cutting-edge technologies including cloud computing, data analytics, and the Internet of Things. Through the utilization of Internet of Things devices, the Real-Time Stock Inventory Management System’s cloud-based infrastructure enhances scalability, accessibility, and flexibility while providing accurate real-time tracking of inventory quantities, locations, and statuses.

articleTitle: Determining People’s Opinion about Amazon Alexa using Machine Learning (ML) based Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In today’s e-commerce, understanding public sentiment towards products is crucial for business growth. Analysing customer feedback poses a challenge due to the increased volume of data. The proposed method addresses this challenge effectively, offering insights critical for informed decision-making. Leveraging machine learning algorithms, this study extracts valuable insights from extensive customer reviews. This research study utilizes data from Kaggle’s Amazon Alexa review dataset, comprising nearly 3000 customer reviews and ratings. Through rigorous analysis, this study has achieved an impressive 94% accuracy rate in discerning customer sentiments. This method not only enhances understanding of consumer perceptions but also provides actionable insights for product development and marketing strategies. By harnessing the power of machine learning, businesses can gain invaluable insights into customer opinions, enabling them to adapt and thrive in the competitive e-commerce landscape.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Feature Extraction and Prediction of Bacterial Leaf Blight Disease in Paddy Fields
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Paddy farming plays a critical role in global food security, yet diseases like Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB) pose significant threats to crop yield and quality. Early detection and accurate diagnosis are essential for effective disease management. This research study investigates machine learning methods for feature extraction and prediction of BLB in paddy fields. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of paddy leaf images, several machine learning models including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), k-Nearest Neighbours (kNN), and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) were trained and evaluated. Performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score were employed to assess the effectiveness of each model. The comparative analysis discusses the strengths and limitations of each method, focusing on those that demonstrate superior capability in early and accurate detection of BLB. These findings provide valuable insights for agricultural scientists and practitioners to enhance disease management strategies using modern machine learning techniques. By leveraging this knowledge, specialists can optimize interventions and improve agricultural practices to mitigate the impact of diseases like BLB on paddy farming and ensure global food security.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Prediction of the Lung Disease using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The application of cutting-edge technologies in caused by the unwanted thickening of the areas in the lungs which can due to fibrosis), pneumonia (a condition where the alveoli or sacs in one or both of healthcare has the potential to transform diagnostic capacities and enhance patient care. This research investigates how deep learning and mobile app development may work together in analyzing X-ray images to detect lung problems. With the help of Flutter’s adaptability and Convolutional Neural Networks’ (CNNs) capability, the proposed system enables real-time X-ray image processing on mobile devices. The proposed solution provides a user-friendly tool for accurate diagnosis and prompt intervention to healthcare practitioners with effective data preprocessing, model training, and interaction with the Flutter framework. Beyond its current deployment, the future scope of this study includes the potential for additional improvement, growth into other medical imaging modalities, and integration with cloud-based healthcare systems. By applying more innovation and collaboration, digital technology can improve healthcare outcomes and enhance the well-being of patients across the globe.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Classifiers in Predicting Car Insurance Claim
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Insurance claims pose a significant and costly challenge for insurance companies. Managing insurance claims presents a fundamental issue for insurance firms. Insurers continually face the challenge of mitigating the escalation of claim losses due to fraudulent activities and the increasing volume of claim data within their operations. Consequently, accurately assessing the status of insured claims during the review process becomes increasingly complex. In order to make the car insurance claim prediction more accurate and feasible a comparison study on the performance of various machine learning and deep learning algorithms is presented in this paper. In this research study, the primary research contribution is that various machine learning and deep learning algorithms like logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, catboost, multilayer perceptron etc. have been analyzed and performance has been evaluated based on the accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC AUC and confusion matrices. This study shows that some algorithms outperform the others and the Random Forest (RF) algorithm has resulted with the highest accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 0 \%}$.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Vehicle with Self-Balance Approach using Gyroscopic Effect and Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Bicycles, bikes, and other two-wheeled vehicles are ubiquitous and serve an essential role in transportation, making them a critical component of basic human mobility needs. Despite their widespread use, the fundamental design of these vehicles has remained relatively unchanged for a long time, always requiring a rider for balance and navigation. Stability is a significant concern for two-wheeled vehicles within the complex transportation system. Balancing a two-wheeled vehicle is inherently more challenging than a four-wheeled one. This study compares the mechanisms for constructing an inline two-wheel electric bike that can self-balance using a gyroscope, demonstrating how this technology can enhance transportation safety and reduce accidents. The concept of gyroscopic precession is central to the construction and analysis of a self-balancing two-wheeler. By leveraging the gyroscopic effect, it becomes possible to balance a bike even in the absence of a human rider. The main idea is that by actively controlling the motion of the gyroscope relative to the vehicle’s body, a stabilizing moment is generated. This study proposes the use of a BLDC motor and a servo for steering control to power an autonomous bike, equipped with a control system designed to prevent it from toppling over, whether in motion or stationary. The primary objective of this research study is to construct a prototype bike that uses a reaction wheel for self-balancing. Data from an MPU-6050 sensor, which measures the tilt angle, is used to inform the vehicle’s responses, ensuring it maintains an upright stance on its two wheels. The sensor continuously monitors the bike’s tilt and provides feedback to the control system, which then adjusts the reaction wheel accordingly to maintain balance. This innovative approach not only promises to make two-wheeled transportation safer but also showcases the potential for integrating advanced gyroscopic technology into everyday vehicles, thereby reducing the risk of accidents and enhancing overall stability.

articleTitle: Deep Fake Detection using Adversarial Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The rise of deepfake technology has resulted in unprecedented challenges in the field of digital media verification, posing significant threats to personal security, misinformation, and trust in digital content. In response to this pressing issue, this study presents an advanced deepfake detection system using deep learning approach. Specifically, the proposed system integrates ResNeXt and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architectures to accurately identify the manipulated content. By leveraging the spatial-temporal features captured by these combined architectures, the proposed system aims to enhance the detection rate of deepfakes across various media formats. The proposed approach offers a robust solution to counteract the evolving sophistication of deepfake technology, thereby enhancing the integrity and authenticity of digital media content.

articleTitle: Intelligent Power Distribution System for Enhanced Renewable Energy Utilization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents an innovative approach to power management, focusing on the optimized utilization of renewable energy sources. By integrating intelligent control algorithms with a microcontroller based system, the proposed framework dynamically regulates the distribution of power from solar panels, wind turbines, and AC mains supply to efficiently charge a 12V battery. Prioritizing renewable sources over conventional energy, the system ensures enhanced sustainability while maximizing energy utilization. Through real-time monitoring and adaptive load management strategies, critical loads receive uninterrupted power supply, even under fluctuating energy conditions. The integration of voltage regulation and inversion further stabilizes power distribution, guaranteeing consistent performance. Overall, the developed system showcases significant advancements in renewable energy utilization and offers promising prospects for sustainable power management in various applications.

articleTitle: Ensemble Strategies for Predicting Walmart Sales Using Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study looks into predictive modeling in the retail sector, with a specific focus on improving sales price predictions for Walmart’s extensive product line. It uses advanced machine learning algorithms and statistical models to rigorously analyze historical sales data alongside external factors such as economic indicators and seasonal trends in order to generate effective models. Our research uses approaches such as Light GBM, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Cat Boosting, and K Nearest Neighbors to explore the complex interplay between pricing dynamics and consumer behavior. Our findings not only promote predictive analytics in retail, but also have practical implications for industry practitioners, particularly Walmart, in terms of pricing strategies, inventory management, and overall business performance. We show that the voting ensemble strategy outperforms averaging by accurately improving predictive accuracy across varied base model combinations.

articleTitle: Progressive Learning Framework for Speech Enhancement using Multi-scale Convolution and S-TCN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing prevalence of deep-learning methods for enhancing speech. Recent research has focused on capturing speech’s long-range dependencies efficiently to enhance performance. However, many studies on speech enhancement typically overlook the distributions of speech signal’s energy in the time-frequency (T-F) domain, a crucial factor for accurately predicting masks. An enhancement model of target speech based on long-term and T-F distributions is presented in this paper. The Feature extraction and reconstruction make up the system. There is a significant limitation to traditional CNNs, which is the use of a fixed-sized kernel, which compromises local as well as contextual data. It is overcomed using multiscale convolution-based feature extractor blocks (MSCFEB) in the extractor. Different kernel sizes are used in a single layer for capturing the interaction of both local as well as contextual information in the signal. There is a time-frequency attention (TFA) module following each MSCFEB in the feature extractor. By usingTFA, varying attention weights are allocated to each time-frequency spectral component. This allows model to focus on specific time frames and frequency channels. By stacking several filtering modules (FMs), the spectrum reconstruction module(SRM) facilitates reconstruction of a spectrum in a progressive manner to reduce magnitude noise. Furthermore, spectrum estimation is ultimately achieved by unfolding the filtering modules repeatedly, gradually improving the intermediate outcome across stages. Tests are conducted with the common voice dataset to validate the proposed approach. The results demonstrate that this model outperformed previous baseline systems.

articleTitle: Development of a Solar Powered Autonomous Multipurpose Agriculture Robot for Sustainable Farming Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research work focuses on developing a helioagribot to enhance agricultural efficiency and sustainability. The proposed system uses solar energy and a microcontroller-based control unit to autonomously manage components like motors and sensors. Solar panels generate energy stored in a battery for continuous operation, even in low light. A DC to DC converter ensures optimal voltage levels. The Atmega 328P microcontroller acts as the CPU, utilizing ultrasonic sensors for obstacle detection and distance measurement. It controls DC motors through motor drivers and relays, enabling precise movement and mechanical operations. This versatile system can perform tasks such as crop monitoring, irrigation, and pest control, promoting sustainable agriculture through renewable energy and autonomous functionality. Challenges include ensuring continuous operation during low sunlight or bad weather by managing energy efficiently and maintaining battery longevity. System integration must ensure component compatibility and reliable software for overall performance. Durability and easy maintenance are vital, given the harsh agricultural environment. Addressing these challenges will enable the helioagribot to significantly contribute to sustainable agriculture through renewable energy and advanced automation.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Cardiovascular Health: Unveiling Insights, Enhancing Interpretability, and Charting Future Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)

authors.preferredName: Katakam Naga Venkata Anjani Siva Sri Lasya
authors.firstName: Katakam Naga Venkata Anjani Siva Sri

abstract: Heart disease is still a major global health concern, which makes the creation of reliable and treatment necessary. This research study analyzes a large dataset that includes cardiovascular risk variables by using cutting-edge technologies by considering clinical measurements, lifestyle factors, and demographic data. The study uses well-known Python tools for data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and predictive modeling, including NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn. Statistical and visual techniques are used in exploratory data analysis to find patterns and relationships present in the dataset. The relationships between gender, forms of chest discomfort, and the existence is investigated by using chi-squared testing and visualization approaches. The significance of several characteristics are also analyzed in this study. To determine possible risk factors, the relationship between categorical variables is measured using the Cramer’s V statistic. Correlation matrices are also utilized to investigate the connections between numerical variables. An extensive analysis of feature importance is also included in the conclusion, highlighting the factors that have a major impact on the prognosis. Bar charts are used as visualization tools to reveal the significance of different parameters in the prediction models.

articleTitle: DietRx: Machine Learning Enhanced Disease Specific Nutrition and Precautions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study presents an innovative approach to disease prediction using the Random Forest machine learning model. Designed to handle the complexities of large, multidimensional medical datasets, this system enhances predictive accuracy by leveraging Random Forest’s robust capabilities in classification and regression. By integrating numerous decision trees to work as an ensemble, the model not only increases the accuracy but also minimizes the likelihood of overfitting, which is common in predictive healthcare analytics. The system is evaluated on various disease datasets, demonstrating substantial improvements in predictive performance compared to traditional single-algorithm approaches. This paper details the system’s architecture, its implementation, and the significant potential it holds for early disease detection and intervention.

articleTitle: Group Key Management and Sharing Protocol in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In cloud computing environments, secured group communication is vital for protecting shared resources and ensuring authorized access. Group key management and sharing protocols play a critical role in maintaining the data security by enabling efficient and secure key distribution among group members. Cloud computing is a model wherein resources on the Internet establish a resource pool and may be dynamically assigned to diverse applications as well as services. Ensuring security in cloud storage is not easy. As data on cloud is beyond the control area of authentic participants, shared data should be made usable on demand of authentic users. Shared data are vulnerable to misplaced or erroneously altered by Cloud Service Provider (CSP) or attackers. Defending data from illegal removal, alteration and fabrication is also challenging. Hence, in this paper Group Key Management and Sharing Protocol (GKMSP) is proposed. Group Key is produced by the data owner, while private and public keys are generated by the Trusted Authority (TA). The proposed scheme offers improved results in terms of Communication and storage costs based on number of groups, key generation and total times based on number of participants and number of participants based on size of attributes in contrast to benchmarked Self-healing Attribute-based Privacy-aware Data Sharing (SAPDS), Access Control Mechanism for P2P Storage Cloud (ACPC) and Robust and Auditable Access Control (RAAC) schemes.

articleTitle: An Android Application for Enhancing Agri-Tourism and Wetland Conservation through Farmer-Consumer Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In recent years, the agricultural sector has faced numerous challenges, including inadequate capacity to host agritourists, limited processing of viewable products, and a scarcity of knowledgeable practitioners. These barriers hinder the growth and development of agri-tourism, which is crucial for sustainable development and conservation efforts. Sustainable tourism has emerged as a significant force in conserving agricultural wetlands, bolstering local economies by creating jobs, and enhancing the income of those working in proximity to wetlands. In response to these challenges, this article introduces a novel initiative to develop an Android application aimed at bridging the communication gap between urban consumers and rural farmers. The app is designed to facilitate direct interaction, promote agricultural awareness, and enable knowledge exchange in crop science. Through this platform, users can gain insights into agricultural practices by virtually visiting farms, thus promoting community engagement and supporting agri-tourism. This system not only aims to improve the conservation of agricultural wetlands but also strives to elevate the socioeconomic status of farmers by integrating them into the value chain of agri-tourism. The dual objectives of creating an efficient digital tool and promoting sustainable tourism through enhanced agri-tourism practices underscore the potential of technology in achieving economic sustainability and environmental conservation in rural landscapes.

articleTitle: Impacting of COVID-19 on Stock Market Exchange using ML
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study analyses the impact of COVID-19 pandemic on stock market exchange by using Machine Learning (ML) techniques. The main aim of this study is to understand how the crisis has influenced stock prices and market dynamics. This study proposes a comprehensive methodology to analyse extensive datasets, select relevant machine learning algorithms, and carefully analyse various features and variables. The findings highlight the key trends and patterns on how machine learning models are predicting market movements during the times of crisis. The research implications offer valuable perspectives for investors, policymakers, and researchers.
