Moreover, this study not only contributes to the understanding of the complex relationship between COVID-19 and stock market behavior but also highlights the efficacy of Machine Learning (ML) in visualizing complex financial dynamics.

articleTitle: Hardware Integration of IoT and GSM for Secured Electrical Line System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research work aims to address the safety concerns associated with unauthorized power activation during electrical line maintenance activities. The primary aim of this study is to design and implement a robust safety system that prevents accidental power activation by unauthorized personnel while maintenance work is in progress. By incorporating a lock mechanism controlled by a password authentication system and utilizing communication technology such as GSM modules, this study aims to ensure that only authorized individuals can activate or deactivate power during maintenance operations. Ultimately, the project seeks to enhance safety standards in electrical maintenance procedures, minimizing the risk of accidents and ensuring the well-being of maintenance personnel and the public

articleTitle: Dynamic Wireless Charging System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The emergence of electric vehicles (EVs) has highlighted the significance of creating effective and user-friendly charging systems to fulfill the escalating need for environmentally friendly transportation. However, the scalability of the infrastructure and consumer convenience are limited by traditional fixed charging infrastructure. To solve these issues, a unique Dynamic Wireless Charging System (DWCS) is presented in this work. The suggested method makes use of cutting-edge wireless power transfer technologies to allow electric vehicle charging while driving. The system’s dynamic charging characteristics enable it to adjust to the location and speed of the vehicle, resulting in smooth and uninterrupted charging while it is moving. By improving the accessibility and flexibility of EV charging, this strategy lessens range anxiety and promotes the wider use of electric vehicles. The study highlights the DWCS’s potential to completely transform the infrastructure for electric car charging in the future by going over its essential elements, guiding principles, and possible uses.

articleTitle: Self-Charging Electrical Bike
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents the design and execution of a dual battery system, regenerative energy generation, and self-charging electronic bicycle (e-bike). A 12-volt generating motor is located at the front wheel of the e-bike for energy recovery, and a drive motor located at the back wheel powers the vehicle. The integrated energy system consists of two 12-volt battery packs that are controlled by an Arduino Nano microcontroller through a series of switching relays. While the battery with the lower voltage is picked for charging, the battery with the greater voltage is used to power the e-bike. To guarantee the ideal charging voltage, the generator motor’s output is passed via a DC-to-DC step-up converter. An Arduino is interfaced with a potentiometer that serves as a throttle to control speed. By continually controlling and regenerating energy, this configuration seeks to increase the ebike’s operating range. The effectiveness of energy recovery and the smooth transition between charging and powering states are two of the main issues addressed. The design that has been suggested highlights the possibility of using regenerative technology into personal transportation to improve sustainability and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: An Automated Leaf & Fruit Disease Prediction using Transfer Learning and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents an innovative automated system for leaf and fruit disease prediction, utilizing the ResNet model enhanced through transfer learning. The system is designed to recognize a variety of plant diseases from images, enabling early detection and facilitating prompt treatment recommendations. By leveraging a pre-trained ResNet model, the system achieves high accuracy and efficiency, significantly reducing the manual labor typically required in traditional disease diagnosis. Integration of a recommendation module offers actionable insights for disease management customized to specific plant conditions identified in the images. The proposed approach aims to revolutionize agricultural practices by providing a scalable, accurate, and user- friendly tool for farmers and agronomists.

articleTitle: Implementation of Intelligent Farm Guards: Utilizing Bidirectional Monitoring for Motor Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The agriculture sector faces significant challenges in ensuring the efficiency and reliability of farm equipment, particularly motor-driven systems. This research study proposed Intelligent Farm Guards (IFGs), which represent a novel bidirectional monitoring approach to optimize motor efficiency and extend equipment lifespan. This study explores the integration of sensor networks, IoT technology, and advanced analytics to create a comprehensive monitoring system. By analyzing real-time data from motor operations and environmental conditions, IFGs provide actionable insights to farmers, enabling maintenance and efficient resource management. The results demonstrate substantial improvements in motor efficiency, reduced downtime, and lower operational costs, marking a significant advancement in smart farming technologies. This study utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT) to develop and deploy an Intelligent Farm Guard utilizing bidirectional monitoring system for a single-phase DC motor to enable real-time remote monitoring and control using internet. The proposed system combines sensor technologies with IoT communication protocols to facilitate effective data collection and control. Here, the sensors are employed to monitor motor parameters such as voltage, current, speed, and direction. The microcontroller processes the data from sensors and transmits it wirelessly to a cloud-based platform using IoT protocols.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Real Estate Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The dynamic nature of real estate markets gives rise to huge challenges for buyers and sellers in accurately predicting property prices. This paper presents a detailed study on real estate price predictions, focusing on using machine learning techniques to forecast property prices effectively. Using a dataset from Bengaluru, as a case study, it explored the intricacies of Real Estate markets and developed a predictive model to estimate the property prices. Our studies consist of data preprocessing, featuring engineering, model selection, and evaluations, giving insights into the factors that affect property prices and the performances of various regression algorithms. After performing multiple experiments, we showcase the efficiency of our approaches in predicting property prices. Existing techniques that have tried to predict house prices have often struggled to deal with nonlinear relationships present among the factors. Recent techniques such as Linear regression, Ridge and Lasso Regression and Support Vector Machines(SVM) have come up short of being perfect when it comes to dealing with computational intensity and these techniques require extensive hyperparameter tuning. However, our predictive model is able to deal with these challenges by leveraging the strengths of Random Forest regression. This is done with high accuracy and the implications for real estate stakeholders are discussed, subsequently. This paper also highlights the various avenues through which the performance of real estate estimation models can be improved in the future.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: FO-RS-3TM: A High-Performance Ensemble Model for Heart Disease Prediction with Feature Selection and Hyperparameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Despite huge advances in cardiac disease prediction, there are still critical research gaps. These include creating more accurate and reliable prediction models that can handle various data kinds and account for complex risk factor connections. A novel heart disease prediction method is presented in this study to cover these shortcomings. The dataset imbalance is addressed by using SMOTE. To manage outliers, Z-Score normalization is used. Firefly Optimization improves relevant feature selection. Random Search also improves 3-tier ensemble model performance by fine-tuning hyperparameters. The recommended strategy improves predictions by fixing dataset errors and modifying model parameters. As proposed, the FO-RS-3-tier Ensemble Model performs well with 98.53% accuracy. Also, accuracy, recall, F1 score, and AUC score are considerably high. This research improves heart disease prediction using cutting-edge methods, highlighting the need for enabling a comprehensive predictive analytics approach in healthcare. These findings suggest monitoring cardiovascular health and enhancing predictive modeling to improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Smart Pendant System for Disease Diagnosis and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In today’s society, where people are often confined to a sedentary lifestyle and suffer from stress, it becomes increasingly difficult to maintain good health. We propose a revolutionary solution to this urgent problem: a wearable system. By integrating multiple sensors and microcontrollers, our innovation aims to revolutionize the bio-medical and biotechnology fields as well. This advanced technology offers a prioritized approach to health management, allowing people to detect and predict potential diseases or health conditions. Our wearable system emphasizes not only the identification of health risks, but also proactive measures to improve overall wellbeing. By continuously monitoring vital signs and activity levels, people gain a personalized understanding of their health. With this knowledge, they can make lifestyle choices and take control of their health. By integrating seamlessly into everyday life, our wearable systems promote a culture of self-care and empower people to prioritize health. Through early detection and proactive intervention, we aim to prevent the spread of health-related problems, ultimately fostering healthier and happier communities.

articleTitle: Navigating Car Price Predictions: Unveiling Machine Learning Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study analyzes car price prediction utilizing machine learning models such as LightGBM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost regressors with a comprehensive dataset containing diverse car attributes. Through rigorous evaluation, this study intends to identify the most accurate predictor. LightGBM emerges as a efficient model, achieving minimal Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.1 and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.316, closely followed by CatBoost. Additionally, the ensemble model demonstrates strong performance with the lowest MSE (0.08) and RMSE (0.282). These findings contribute to advancing machine learning applications in car valuation, providing valuable guidance to consumers in their purchasing decisions..

articleTitle: Dynamic Predictive Analysis of Blood Glucose Levels using CNN with Real-time Feedback Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Within the domain of diabetes management, predicting blood glucose levels accurately and dynamically plays a major role in providing effective treatment and prevention of complications. This research work introduces a novel a strategy that makes use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to predict diabetic blood glucose values patients. Unlike static models, our method incorporates a real-time feedback mechanism, allowing for dynamic adjustments based on evolving physiological and environmental factors. Leveraging extensive datasets encompassing patient demographics, lifestyle factors, and physiological indicators, our CNN-based model demonstrates superior accuracy and adaptability. Furthermore, incorporating a real-time feedback mechanism empowers clinicians and patients with timely insights, enabling proactive interventions help keep blood glucose levels at their ideal levels and mitigate risks of hypo- or hyperglycemia events. Through performance evaluation and validation against standard clinical practices, our approach showcases promising advancements in personalized diabetes care, heralding a new era of precision medicine in chronic disease management.

articleTitle: Imputation and Clustering of Incomplete Data using K-Nearest Neighbors and DBSCAN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Missing values, a persistent challenge in data analysis across various domains, are addressed in this work through a novel approach that combines K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) imputation and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) for robust clustering. KNN imputation leverages the information from a data point’s knearest neighbors within complete data to estimate missing values, resulting in a more accurate representation of the underlying data distribution. Following imputation, DBSCAN, known for its resilience to outliers and noise commonly encountered in real-world data, is employed for clustering. This combined approach offers a two-fold advantage: 1) effectively handling missing values with KNN imputation, and 2) achieving robust clustering with DBSCAN, particularly beneficial for datasets often containing outliers and missing entries. The effectiveness of this approach is evaluated on multiple datasets (specify the number and types of datasets used), demonstrating its generalizability across different data domains. This study concludes by discussing about the potential future research directions for further exploration.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based System to Prevent Animal Accidents in the Railway Tracks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The wildlife population has been in danger due to frequent animal accidents on railway tracks. In India, animal train collisions cause an average of 20 elephant deaths every year all over the nation. At the same time railway departments are taking necessary steps to identify the cause and implement prevention methods. Despite this, lots of accidents are happening in the railway tracks near the forest areas. This problem has been addressed by proposing a well-defined technological mechanism to alert the animals to be away from the railway tracks to reduce the wildlife deaths. In this study, Machine Learning(ML) frameworks are employed to detect the animals that are coming near the railway tracks and the developed module will provide appropriate warning or signals to the animals as well as to the loco pilot.

articleTitle: Navigating the Terrain: A Comprehensive Survey of Deep Learning for Image Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The increase in image forgery is due to the emergence of digital image processing technology, which necessitates the need to detect such fraudulent activities. This study proposes a new approach to address this challenge using Python and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. The proposed CNN model has achieved a training accuracy of 99% and a testing accuracy of 90%, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing the authenticity of the images. The data used in this study includes 12,615 images, including 7,492 real images (real) and 5,123 falsified (fake) images. To improve the accuracy of the proposed approach, error analysis is included as a preliminary step. All the input images are converted to standard 256x256 resolution and ELA is applied. ELA helps to identify the main areas in an image that exhibit different levels of compression. An undamped image shows good compression in all areas. Deviations from this consistency may indicate numerical manipulation. The resulting images are then stored as NumPy arrays for later analysis. The proposed scheme uses a combination of labels developed using CNN, deep learning and ELA. This combination allows the proposed model to not only achieve high accuracybut also provide an in-depth insight into specific areas of the image.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Multi-Factor Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study investigates the complex dynamics affecting crop production prediction using a multi-faceted method that incorporates temperature, rainfall, and pesticide application. With the use of cutting-edge machine learning models including S VR, Random Forest, Lasso, and XGBoost, the study carefully examines how these variables affect agricultural productivity. The yield-to-rainfall ratio is a new statistic established to measure agricultural production efficiency in relation to average rainfall patterns. The generated models are rigorously optimized using grid search approaches, which demonstrate their strong predictive power. The study reveals the complex links between crop yields, climatic conditions, and pesticides through detailed visualizations and correlation analyses. Among the regression models, the XGBoost model performs better than the others and is found to be the best predictor. The findings provide useful insights for maximizing crop output in a range of environmental circumstances and greatly advance our understanding of important factors influencing agricultural productivity. A fresh viewpoint on crop efficiency is offered by the yield-to-rainfall ratio, which makes it easier to identify crops and areas with the highest productivity.

articleTitle: Assessing the Resilience of Machine Learning Models in Predicting Long-Term Breast Cancer Recurrence Results
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Breast cancer is still one of the leading causes of death and disability among females globally, and China is quickly becoming one of the leading countries in terms of both incidence and mortality rates. Recurrence is still a concern for many patients, especially those with triple-negative or hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, even though screening and therapy options have improved. More precise and tailored methods are required as traditional prognostic models based on clinical factors often do not accurately forecast recurrence. Using clinical and pathological data from 200 patients, this research assesses how well machine learning algorithms predict the outcomes of long-term breast cancer recurrence. Some of the challenges are data heterogeneity, insufficient amounts of related samples with imbalanced classes, ability to interpret complex models, and model’s interchangeability across the range of patient cases. Metrics including recall, specificity, accuracy, and F1 score are used to evaluate four popular machine learning models: neural networks, decision trees, K-Nearest Neighbors (K-NN), and logistic regression. When it comes to classification accuracy $(\mathrm{CA}=0.94)$ and discriminatory ability $(\mathrm{AUC}=0.98)$, the findings show that the neural network model performs the best overall. Afterwards, K-NN and logistic regression come in second and third, respectively, behind the decision tree model. The results of this study highlight the promise of machine learning algorithms in guiding tailored treatment plans for breast cancer patients and improving their prognosis. Improved recurrence prediction and management allows healthcare practitioners to better allocate resources and offer optimal patient care, leading to advancements in breast cancer research and therapy.

articleTitle: A Novel AI-Driven Recommendation System for Eco-Conscious Consumers
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The fashion industry is witnessing a rapid technological shift, with a growing emphasis on sustainability and eco-consciousness. Consumers are displaying heightened awareness of environmental concerns, leading to a surge in demand for ethical and ecologically responsible fashion products and services. AI-based fashion recommendation systems have emerged as a potential solution, aiding consumers in making environmentally sound wardrobe choices. This research investigates the potential of such systems in empowering ecoconscious consumers to build sustainable wardrobes. A novel algorithm, EcoLearnFuse, is introduced. It integrates autoencoders and gradient boosting techniques to enhance recommendation accuracy while promoting eco-friendly fashion selections. Comparative analysis is conducted against existing algorithms using established simulation metrics, encompassing recommendation precision, environmental impact assessment, and computational efficiency. The simulations demonstrate that EcoLearnFuse surpasses existing algorithms, highlighting its effectiveness in guiding users towards eco-conscious fashion decisions. The proposed framework incorporates persuasive design elements to positively influence consumer behavior, aligning with the broader goals of sustainable fashion adoption. This study contributes to the advancement of AI-driven solutions for promoting environmental sustainability within the fashion industry, ultimately fostering a more conscious and responsible consumer culture.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Anomaly and Threat Detection for Surveillance Footage Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the domain of video monitoring, achieving effective anomaly and threat detection has remained a persistent challenge, marked by the limitations of traditional systems, which often suffer from high false positive rates and operational inefficiencies. Traditional systems often fall short due to their reliance on manual monitoring and basic automated rules, leading to high false positive rates and inefficiencies. This study proposes a novel approach by utilizing advanced AI technologies, including the Inflated 3D (I3D) model, sophisticated anomaly detection and object detection models. The proposed system is designed to enhance accuracy and agility in identifying unusual activities in surveillance footage. By leveraging these state-of-the-art models, this study aims to reduce the burden on human operators and improve the adaptability of surveillance systems across diverse environments. This study lays the groundwork for incorporating advanced detection strategies, contributing to the creation of safer public and private spaces through enhanced security measures.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) Performance with Internet of Things (IoT)-based Audio-Visual Feedback Device
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) stands as a crucial intervention for individuals experiencing cardiac arrest, yet its demanding nature underscores the necessity for innovations to augment its efficacy. In light of this challenge, we developed an IoT-integrated CPR rescue system, utilizing Arduino and Bluetooth technology for their flexibility and seamless interoperability. The IoT-integrated CPR rescue system demonstrated acceptable sensitivity in detecting BPM, with near-accurate rates displayed for SPO2 levels. Despite a latency of around 200 milliseconds, the system provided prompt CPR guidance, ensuring effective response times and user satisfaction. This study offers valuable insights into the development of cost-effective and highly accurate CPR assistance systems, which contribute to the advancement of emergency medical care and provide significant benefits to the research community. Future research may explore optimizations and integration with established healthcare infrastructure to further amplify outcomes in cardiac emergencies

articleTitle: Malware Detection for Android Systems using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Android’s irresistible acceptance as the most popular smartphone operating system has brought about a surge in malware instances compared to previous years. This surge necessitates robust anti-malware solutions to safeguard users’ sensitive mobile data from such threats. Through examination, various Android malware types and their tactics, coupled with deep learning approaches, have been analyzed for their roles in attacking devices, while antivirus programs have been assessed for their efficacy in protective Android systems. The discussion revolves around various deep acquisition-based techniques for determining Android adwa re, such as Maldozer, Droid-Detector, Droid-Deep-Learner, Deep-Flow, Droid-Delver, and Droid-Deep. The goal is to create a deep learning model that can detect whether an Android application has malware automatically and doesn’t need to be installed.

articleTitle: AI based Stock Market Analysis and Decision Making System using Design Thinking Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Stock market is a dynamic and ever-changing environment that can be both exciting and challenging for investors. Equities, primarily referred to as stocks, are traded on stock exchanges around the world and reflect ownership in a business. The stock market is an essential tool for companies to raise capital, and investors use it to grow their wealth. Investing in stocks requires a thorough understanding of the market and the individual companies in which you are interested. The financial health of a company must be taken into account and can be analyzed using financial statements and other data. Another critical factor is the overall economic climate, as market conditions can significantly impact stock prices. It’s crucial to have a long-term outlook and avoid being influenced by momentary market changes when making equity investments. A random walk is a mathematical model used to describe a sequence of steps or movements where each step is determined by chance. It is often used in various fields, including physics, finance, and statistics. Random walk theory has important implications in various fields, including the efficient market hypothesis in finance and the modeling of diffusion processes in physics. To effectively predict the future stock price using conventional and modern machine learning models. Compare the performance of different models and identify a higher accuracy prediction model using the selected important factors from disparate data sources.

articleTitle: Biological Data Analysis for Disease Prediction and Classification in Bioinformatics
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: A type of cancer known as leukemia occurs when many immature lymphocyte blood cells develop and obstruct the development of other blood cells. Leukemia is typically detectable through the use of the Complete Blood Count (CBC) test. Leukemia is indicated by either an excess or a shortage of a certain type of blood cell in the complete blood count (CBC). Leukemia can be lethal in adults even though it affects youngsters 80% of the time. Therefore, early leukemia detection is critical to saving lives. Rapid leukemia diagnosis can be facilitated by computer technology. After that, the features were used to train and evaluate several machine learning classification methods, including SVM, and Random Forest. The most effective classifier can be found by comparing its performance against several performance criteria, such as accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Predicting Hate Words and Offensive Language: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The internet has led to a significant increase in the amount of information available, which has resulted in the rise of online communication among users. Unfortunately, this has also resulted in the proliferation of toxic online texts, which can lead to bullying, harassment, and personal attacks. While there have been attempts to develop efficient models for predicting toxic comments online, the field is still in its nascent stage, hence new frameworks and strategies are needed to address this issue. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are a promising solution for text classification due to recent advancements in hardware and big data management. Additionally, the increasing amount of data available necessitates the development of novel machine learning tools for managing this information. This study compares CNNs with the traditional bag-of-words approach as well as more efficient methods for text classification. The results demonstrate that CNNs outperform the conventional method in classifying harmful comments, indicating the approach’s potential for further research in this field. This work highlights the importance of developing innovative strategies to combat online toxicity and provides insight into how deep learning techniques can be used for text classification.

articleTitle: Industry Internet of Things (IIoT) Adoption Pressures in SME OEMs
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Small and Medium Original Equipment Manufacturers (SME OEMs) face challenges in IIoT adoption due to a lack of technical expertise, additional costs, and preferences of the end-users and significant institutional pressures. This research investigates the influence of Environmental Attitude on the Adoption Intention of Industry Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies among Small and Medium Enterprises and Original Equipment Manufacturers (SME-OEMs). This research analyses the effects of End-user Pull and Institutional Pressure in this relationship. A survey of 263 SME OEMs from 11 industrial sectors across 67 cities was conducted using purposive sampling. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was used to analyze data, assessing direct and indirect effects. Results show a significant positive relationship between Environmental Attitude and IIoT Adoption Intention. Mediation analysis reveals significant indirect effects through End-user Pull and Institutional Pressure, with complete mediation as the direct effect becomes insignificant. Findings highlight the crucial role of environmental attitude in shaping IIoT adoption intentions among SMEs. A positive environmental attitude drives SMEs to explore IIoT benefits. End-user Pull and Institutional Pressure are key mediators in this process. These insights are valuable for industry stakeholders, policymakers, and SMEs aiming to promote IIoT adoption. Fostering a positive environmental attitude and leveraging End-user Pull and Institutional Pressure can facilitate IIoT adoption. Policymakers can create initiatives to raise environmental awareness and encourage sustainable practices through IIoT. Industry players can form strategic partnerships to support SME OEMs in IIoT adoption.

articleTitle: Improving Solar Energy Conversion Efficiency through Luo Converter Enhanced by Artificial Neural Network and Cloud Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the field of renewable energy systems, the focus on abundance and sustainability has propelled solar power to the forefront. Despite its popularity, optimizing solar energy conversion and utilization efficiency remains a significant challenge. In order to address this challenge, this research study introduces a novel approach: The integration of an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller with a Luo Boost Converter to create a solar charge controlling based efficient load distributing system. The proposed system utilizes Photovoltaic (PV) panels for solar energy collection, storing the harvested energy in a battery bank. An ANN controller operates the Luo Boost Converter, ensuring optimal distribution by efficiently transforming the battery’s stored DC voltage into a steady, increased output voltage capable of powering AC loads upon inversion. Leveraging the ANN controller enhances the system’s responsiveness and adaptability to varying load demands and environmental conditions, enabling real-time adjustments for peak efficiency. Precise control facilitated by the ANN optimizes the load distribution process, ensuring efficient utilization of available solar energy without wastage. This innovative strategy aims to advance solar energy system development by enhancing both distribution and harvesting domains. Additionally, the incorporation of cloud integration technology enables remote monitoring of voltage levels within the Luo converter via smartphones or computers. Furthermore, a voltage sensor triggers an alarm or buzzer in case of overvoltage or undervoltage scenarios, empowering users to identify and address issues promptly. Through the fusion of advanced control techniques with effective power conversion technology, the proposed model not only promises improved performance and viability of solar energy systems but also promotes sustainable energy practices for a greener future.

articleTitle: Sustainable Engineering: Predictive Modeling of Aluminum Matrix Composites using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In this research, the “Composite Property Prediction Neural Network” (CPPNN) is introduced as a deep learning algorithm designed for predicting the mechanical properties of aluminum matrix composites (AMCs) reinforced with coconut shell particles (CSP). Trained on the CSP-AMC Mechanical Properties Dataset, it comprises various CSP fraction values, composition condition details, and corresponding mechanical test results. Considered CSP fraction values range from 0% to $\mathbf{8 \%}$, alongside diverse compocasting conditions including temperature, pressure, and stirring time. Mechanical test results include microhardness and ultimate tensile strength (UTS) measurements from experimental testing of the fabricated composites. Through extensive training iterations, the CPPNN learns intricate relationships between input parameters (CSP fraction, compocasting conditions, Compocasting Pressure, Stirring Time) and output properties (Microhardness, UTS), enabling accurate prediction of mechanical performance for new composite formulations. Inspections of the model’s recall, accuracy, precision, and F1 score offer insight on the manner in which it performs. Leveraging the predictive capabilities of the CPPNN can expedite the materials development process, reducing the need for extensive experimental testing while providing valuable insights into the influence of composition and processing parameters on composite properties. The CPPNN stands as a significant advancement in predictive modeling for composite materials, offering a data-driven approach to enhance efficiency and sustainability in materials design and optimization.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The increasing concerns regarding climate change, notably the surge in greenhouse gas emissions, have attained paramount significance in the agendas of both U.S. and global policy makers. Transportation, responsible for $29 \%$ of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), stands as the nation’s leading contributor to this challenge. In parallel, substantial policy initiatives at the national and state levels are underway, and key automotive manufacturers like Ford, GM, and Volvo have committed to a complete transition to electric vehicles (EVs) within the next decade, heralding a profound shift in the automotive industry. This impending transformation, combined with public and private sector efforts, is poised to generate a substantial increase in EV demand. Governments and public utilities can use this research to build and manage public charging networks strategically by applying machine learning models to forecast energy consumption patterns inside EV charging infrastructure. By proactively forecasting future EV charger energy consumption, this study aims to pinpoint regions of high demand, facilitating optimized infrastructure expansion and resource utilization, aligning with sustainability goals and the evolving EV landscape. We harnessed a real-time dataset comprising 433,172 electric vehicle transactions, including 91,255 new vehicle registrations. We integrated data from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory’s API, encompassing 1,686 charging stations in Washington. Our modeling process, applied uniformly across counties, included seasonal decomposition, training and testing data partitioning, gridsearch with pmdarima for parameter optimization, and SARIMAX modeling for forecasting. Visualization aided in assessing forecast accuracy, contributing to our overall study on EV charging demand prediction.

articleTitle: Construction of a New Smart Production Safety Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study presents the design and implementation of a new intelligent production safety management system tailored to meet the stringent requirements of today’s safety regulations and business needs. The system adopts a layered architecture including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS). Key features include hazard source management, hidden hazard inspection checklists, safety inspection management, hazard remediation, and statistical queries. Development uses a low-code research and development platform based on the JAVA language, utilizing Model-Driven Development (MDD) and Domain-Specific Modeling (DSM) methodologies. The system integrates with IoT technologies for real-time data collection and processing, and supports mobile management for on-the-go inspections. Extensive testing confirms the system’s ability to handle at least 500 simultaneous online users, with performance benchmarks ensuring fast response times for various operations. The system’s design prioritizes scalability, security, and performance optimization to provide comprehensive support for enterprise security management.

articleTitle: Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Industrial Control Systems Using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: For IoT devices to be reliable and secure, anomaly detection is essential, but conventional methods often struggle to handle the distributed data of IoT. Another key challenge is the lack of privacy protection in centralized anomaly detection approaches, which require data to be gathered and analyzed in a central location. Federated Learning (FL) provides a way to train models collaboratively across decentralized Internet of Things devices while protecting the privacy of user data. In this work, an FL-based anomaly detection framework for IoT devices has been proposed, leveraging the FedAvgM algorithm to train an Autoencoder model. This works experimental results demonstrate the framework’s effectiveness in detecting anomalies in IoT traffic data and maintaining data privacy. This work demonstrates how FL can improve IoT system security and dependability while resolving privacy issues related to conventional anomaly detection techniques. By leveraging FL, proposed method has achieved better accuracy than traditional methods while also preserving sensitive IoT data.

articleTitle: An Integrated Mobile Application for Automated Detection of Plant Leaf Diseases and Pest Infestations
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)

authors.preferredName: D. M. Mary Synthia Regis Prabha

abstract: This research study intends to develop a comprehensive mobile application poised to transform agricultural practices by enabling accurate identification of leaf, disease, and pest damage in plants. By analyzing the capabilities of modern smartphone technology, the application will leverage the device’s camera for users to capture images of affected plants. Anchored by an extensive database, featuring a diverse collection of crop and plant images, meticulously curated to showcase various symptoms induced by pests, our application ensures thorough analysis. Advanced algorithms for object detection, image classification, and pattern recognition will be employed to provide precise identification and analysis of user inputs. Additionally, pattern matching algorithms will enable the detection of exact matches within existing patterns. By providing farmers and agricultural professionals with a powerful tool for prompt and reliable identification of plant issues, our application aims to significantly enhance pest management and crop preservation efforts. Our proposed method includes the utilization of 11 features calculated with the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) for precise detection, augmenting the accuracy of our system. Additionally, we integrate hybrid Convolutional Autoencoder (CAE) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models such as ResNetV2 and CNNIR-OWELM, enabling precise identification of plant damage and pest infestation, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of our solution in aiding farmers and agricultural professionals.

articleTitle: EMANet: Revolutionizing Energy Efficiency in Smart Spaces through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the modern smart environments, optimizing energy efficiency stands as a primary objective for attaining sustainability and resource management. Smart spaces, encompassing a variety of environments such as smart buildings, cities, and industrial settings, rely on efficient energy utilization to meet the growing demands of modern society while minimizing environmental impact This study investigates the optimization of energy efficiency within smart environments, a critical objective for sustainable resource management. Smart spaces, encompassing diverse environments like buildings, cities, and industries, require efficient energy utilization to address growing societal demands while minimizing environmental impact. To achieve this, an approach is proposed that leverages Machine Learning (ML) algorithms integrated with Adaptive Personal Area Networks (PANs) for optimized energy consumption. A novel algorithm, EMANet (EnergyManaged Attention Networks), is introduced for dynamic regulation of resource allocation and network configurations based on attention-driven insights. The performance of EMANet is evaluated through comparative simulation analysis against existing algorithms like Q-learning, Particle Swarm Optimization, and Ant Colony Optimization. Metrics including Energy Consumption Reduction, Network Lifetime Extension, and Resource Utilization Efficiency are employed for comparison. This research aims to achieve substantial improvements in energy efficiency through the combined application of ML algorithms and PANs, thereby promoting the sustainability of smart spaces. The results are expected to demonstrate the effectiveness of EMANet in optimizing energy usage and its potential to revolutionize energy management strategies in smart environments.

articleTitle: Enabling Cybersecurity Defenses: Advanced Endpoint Detection, Data Breach Identification, and Anomaly Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)

authors.preferredName: Mantha Sri N V R Snigdha Sindusha
authors.firstName: Mantha Sri N V R Snigdha

abstract: The major purpose of this research project is to study the potential of merging Osquery with Wazuh while simultaneously boosting system and security monitoring. Osquery is an operating system instrumentation framework, while Wazuh is a platform for security information and event management (SIEM). When coupled, they offer a full solution for real-time threat identification, network activity monitoring, and anomaly detection. The setup, configuration, rule development, and active response of Osquery and Wazuh make up the bulk of the study. The study also reveals how these two technologies may work together to boost cybersecurity defenses. A framework for establishing customized anomaly detection criteria and proactive response tactics is also offered in this research study, illustrating the practical applicability of this integrated approach to IT system safety. The results section highlights how rapidly Osquery and Wazuh work together to discover and fix security vulnerabilities. The operation and performance of the proposed system are also explored in this study. The conclusion presents a summary of the study’s most important results and proposes potential options for future research that may be undertaken to enhance Osquery and Wazuh’s capabilities to secure digital assets.

articleTitle: A Survey on Deep Learning Techniques for Secure and Accurate Mobile Sink Position Prediction in Vehicular Pattern WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents a comprehensive survey of deep learning methods applied in order to improve the security along with accuracy of the mobile sink position prediction in Vehicular Pattern Wireless Sensor Networks (V-WSNs). V-WSNs are pivotal in modern wireless communication, especially in dynamic environments like urban traffic systems. The survey begins with an overview of V-WSNs, highlighting their unique characteristics, applications, and challenges, with a particular focus on mobile sink position prediction. It then delves into the nuances of routing protocols in V-WSNs, discussing the advantages and limitations of existing methods, and underscores the necessity for deep learning-based solutions. The paper further explores the integration of deep learning in WSNs, examining its applications, benefits, and inherent challenges. The significance of accurate and secure routing is analyzed, followed by an in-depth discussion on the integration of deep learning for enhancing these aspects in V-WSN routing. The paper also addresses the current challenges and open issues in mobile sink prediction and secure, accurate routing, paving the way for future research directions. A comparative analysis of various deep learning approaches and their practical applications in real-world scenarios is presented, offering insights into the effectiveness of these techniques. The survey concludes by summarizing the key findings and reaffirming the importance of integrating deep learning for secure and accurate mobile sink position prediction in V-WSNs.

articleTitle: An Experimental Study on Prediction of Revenue and Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The proliferation of product variety presents a significant challenge for small retailers grappling with limited space and capital to manage their inventory effectively. This paper addresses this issue by investigating various machine learning and deep learning algorithms for predicting future product demand in small retail establishments. Accurate demand forecasts are crucial not only for optimizing retail operations but also for enhancing the efficiency of the entire supply chain. Leveraging the abundance of data available today, this study explores the application of suitable machine learning algorithms for forecasting, thereby enabling small retailers to maximize their profit margins. In addition to sales forecasting, the research aims to conduct customer segmentation, facilitating informed decision-making to drive revenue generation. By harnessing predictive analytics, small retail shop owners can make strategic decisions that align with market demand and consumer behavior, thereby enhancing their competitiveness in the retail landscape.

articleTitle: Performance-Security Tradeoff of Multi-Dimensional Chaotic Maps for Resource-Constrained Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In today’s interconnected world, resource-limited devices are crucial across various sectors but face significant security challenges due to limited computational resources. Ensuring the security of these devices is crucial to protect against unauthorized access, data breaches, and other cyber threats. Traditional cryptographic approaches may lead to performance bottlenecks and excessive energy consumption, rendering them unsuitable for practical deployment in these devices. To address this, lightweight encryption algorithms are essential to balance security and efficiency. This study explores encryption methods tailored for these devices, using chaos theory principles to develop novel techniques. This study utilizes multidimensional chaotic maps (1D, 2D, 3D, 4D) to generate encryption keys and secure data transmission. This research analyzes security and performance to find a balance between them as dimension increases. This study finds that end-to-end time and memory consumption rise with higher dimensions, enhancing security through uniform pixel distribution in encrypted images, increased key sensitivity, resistance to differential attacks, decreased peak signal-to-noise ratio, and lower pixel correlation. Although entropy and contrast values do not significantly improve, higher values are observed. The research findings indicate that higher dimensions enhance both security and performance, providing insights for optimizing lightweight encryption schemes to meet specific application needs. Through rigorous experimentation, we conclude that the optimal dimension can be selected based on application requirements, effectively balancing security and performance.

articleTitle: Security Measures in Cloud-Driven Home Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Cloud-driven home automation systems are widely used to enable high levels of convenience, efficiency, and connectivity as cloud technology becomes more and more integrated into everyday household operations. Despite these advantages, there is an increasing need to address security issues introduced by smart device interconnectivity and dependence on remote cloud services. Security features in cloud-based home automation systems are essential for guaranteeing the confidentiality, integrity, and dependability of data exchanges and smart device connectivity in residential environment. Strong security protocols and procedures are essential as homes become more networked and dependent on cloud services for automation and remote management. This study addresses the main issues, weak points, and recommended procedures for preventing cyberattacks and unwanted access as it focuses on the complex aspects of security in cloud-driven home automation systems. This study covers a wide range of security topics, including secure communication channels, data encryption, access controls, and authentication methods relevant to the home automation industry. By utilizing the knowledge from industry standards and cybersecurity research, this study looks at ways to mitigate common attack vectors, including malware infections, phishing scams, and unapproved device access. The study also explores the challenges of controlling user consent and privacy in cloud-driven home automation ecosystems, highlighting the significance of open data handling procedures and user-centric privacy controls. This study analyzes the methods employed to minimize data collection and storage, anonymize sensitive information, and provide users with fine-grained control over smart home environment.

articleTitle: An Extensive Analysis of CNN Models for Plant Disease Recognition and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The rise of viral plant diseases poses a significant threat to agricultural productivity and global food security. To address this challenge, this study incorporates state-of-the-art computer vision techniques for performing early disease detection in plants. Building upon existing research in the field, this study focuses on developing deep learning algorithms for accurately identifying different plant diseases. Various Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures, including ResNet50, VGG16, and the EfficientNet series (b0-b7), are explored to determine the most effective solution. Remarkably, EfficientNetB6 and B7 models emerge as the top performers, achieving an accuracy rate of 91.4%. This research not only contributes to the advancement of agricultural sustainability and resilience but also offers strategic insights essential for addressing evolving agricultural challenges. By combining automated deep learning models with expert advice, this study proposes a comprehensive approach to plant disease detection and management, promising more precise and reliable outcomes.

articleTitle: Prediction of Food Ingredient Pairings using Siamese Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The study introduces a novel method for predicting food ingredient pairings using siamese neural networks, a type of neural network architecture renowned for its capacity to learn embeddings and capture semantic similarity. The accurate prediction of ingredient pairings holds significance for recipe recommendation systems and culinary innovation. The proposed approach entails training siamese neural networks on a substantial dataset of recipes, where the networks acquire embeddings for each ingredient and assess their compatibility through comparison. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through comprehensive evaluation on the dataset, highlighting its capability to accurately forecast ingredient pairings.

articleTitle: HairVise: A Machine Learning, Augmented Reality and Artificial Intelligence Integrated Personalized Hair Care Recommendation Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: HairVise addresses the pervasive and often complex hair care issues faced by consumers worldwide. From treating different hair types to addressing specific concerns such as dryness, frizz or damage, individuals often struggle to find the right products tailored to their individual needs. In response to this challenge, HairVise has evolved into an innovative e-commerce platform that seamlessly integrates cutting-edge technologies to revolutionize the hair care experience. Leveraging React for its smart interface, Node.js for robust server-side logic, and MongoDB for efficient data management, HairVise uses a machine learning-based approach to provide personalized hair care recommendations. Using a comprehensive questionnaire, user data is carefully collected to tailor product suggestions based on individual hair types, concerns and preferences. Additionally, HairVise has a sophisticated customer support chatbot powered by Natural Language Processing (NLP) that increases user engagement and satisfaction. Augmented reality (AR) implementation further enriches the platform, allowing users to visualize potential hair color changes before purchasing. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the development of HairVise, describing its features, methods and the results achieved through its innovative approach to the hair care trade.

articleTitle: Improving customer churn prediction accuracy: a SMOTE-based approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Predicting customer churn could be a crucial assignment for numerous businesses, especially within the broadcast communication industry where the yearly churn rate can be as high as $40 \%$.This process includes recognizing clients who are likely to take off the company, which is basic for maintenance methodologies and income development. In this context, SMOTE has been connected to a dataset to address the issue of imbalanced information, which can adversely affect the execution of machine learning calculations. SVM has shown promising execution in customer churn prediction compared to other machine learning calculations. Specifically, SVM has demonstrated high accuracy rates and effectiveness in predicting customer churn. By combining SMOTE with SVM, a more accurate customer churn prediction model can be developed, leading to improved retention strategies and revenue growth for businesses.

articleTitle: Enhancing Digital Security: A Comprehensive Multi-Model Authentication Framework Leveraging Cryptography and Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In today’s digital era, the protection of sensitive information is of utmost importance, necessitating the development of robust authentication systems. This paper proposes a multi-model authentication system for secure record retrieval, integrating various authentication factors to enhance security and user experience. The system architecture includes modules for user registration, encryption of credentials using AES and SHA algorithms, two-factor authentication (2FA) with unique QRcodes and one-time passwords (OTPs), and biometric authentication based on palm print recognition technology. The biometric authentication process involves preprocessing palm print images, extracting regions of interest, filtering, scoring, and matching against stored user data. The system ensures seamless integration and compatibility with existing platforms, facilitating easy adoption and deployment across diverse environments. Robust security measures, including brute-force protection, replay attack prevention, and data encryption, are implemented to safeguard sensitive information. Evaluation of the system’s performance through predefined testing scenarios and metrics demonstrates its effectiveness in enhancing security and user satisfaction. This proposed solution addresses the growing need for secure record retrieval systems by providing a comprehensive authentication mechanism that ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and reliability of user data.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Bone Health Predictive Modeling: Integrating Logistic Regression for Precise Outcome Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study presents a complete review of predictive modelling approaches for monitoring bone health condition, a key element of addressing healthcare, particularly for elderly persons. The purpose of our project is to thoroughly understand the elements determining bone health outcomes by merging large-scale social and medical data sets with strong machine learning algorithms. Using complex data preparation, feature development, classification and regression algorithms, this research seeks to identify minor correlations and patterns suggestive of osteoporosis, osteopenia, or normal bone states. The findings illustrate the extraordinary precision with which these prediction models can estimate the condition of bone health, underlining the likelihood that these approaches can be beneficial in clinical settings. These models have the capacity to enhance patient care and long-term health outcomes by providing early diagnosis and treatment, closing a large gap in present healthcare practice.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Music Recommendation Based on Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital music consumption, personalized music recommendation systems have become indispensable tools for enhancing user engagement and satisfaction. However, while current approaches excel in analyzing explicit user preferences and musical attributes, they often overlook the crucial role of emotions in shaping musical experiences. This research proposes a groundbreaking approach to music recommendation based on facial emotion recognition. The dataset used in this study comprises approximately 35,000 images, categorized into seven classes representing different emotion classes. Each image in the dataset is labeled with its corresponding emotion class, enabling supervised learning techniques to be applied effectively.By harnessing the power of facial expressions as indicators of emotional states, our method seeks to offer personalized music recommendations tailored to the user’s current mood and emotional context. Through the integration of advanced techniques in facial emotion recognition and machine learning algorithms, specifically the utilization of a new hybrid methodology AlexNet and Self-Attention-FCN, this paper aims to revolutionize the way music is recommended, emphasizing the importance of emotional resonance in enhancing user experience.

articleTitle: CloudSec Innovation: Enhanced Data Security with Multi-Tier Encryption Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of cloud computing, data security remains a paramount concern, necessitated by the increasing sophistication of cyber threats. Traditional encryption methodologies, primarily Single-Tier systems, are proving insufficient against the advanced tactics employed by modern cyber attackers. The CloudSec Innovation introduces a novel Multi-Tier encryption framework designed to fortify cloud data security by integrating symmetric (AES-256), asymmetric (RSA-OAEP), and post-quantum (Kyber-512) encryption techniques. The system is rigorously evaluated using a dataset simulated to mirror diverse cyber-attack scenarios and data sensitivity levels. The experimental analysis demonstrates a significant enhancement in security efficacy; the Multi-Tier system drastically reduces the success rate of cyber attacks to 5% from the 25% seen with Single-Tier systems, while also prolonging the average breach time from 2 to $\mathbf{1 0}$ hours. These results, tested across scenarios like SQL Injection, Brute Force, and Phishing attacks, attest to the robustness and comprehensive protection offered by the MultiTier approach. Conclusively, ‘CloudSec Innovation’ emerges as a superior solution, providing a sophisticated and layered defense mechanism that is adept at securing sensitive data in cloud environments against an array of cyber threats, thus establishing a new benchmark in cloud data encryption technology.

articleTitle: Exploring Alzheimer’s Disease Risk Prediction: A Data-Driven Approach with RandomForestClassifier
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In this work, we employ a sophisticated machine learning technique based on the RandomForestClassifier model to examine Alzheimer’s disease risk prediction. The “oasis_cross-sectional.csv” and “oasis_longitudinal.csv” full datasets, which comprise both cross-sectional and longitudinal data, serve as the basis for our study. Our research project’s major purpose is to create and assess a prediction model that may identify a person’s chance of getting Alzheimer’s disease based on clinical and demographic characteristics. Our method entails substantial data preparation, including feature engineering, imputation of missing values, and normalization. Feature engineering is a discrete stage. Stratified cross-validation approaches are used to train and modify the RandomForestClassifier model, establishing the validity of the performance metrics. Several important results from our work include evaluations of model correctness, a thorough assessment of prediction abilities, and insights into critical components that contribute to the risk assessment of Alzheimer’s disease. In this chapter, we underline how machine learning may increase Alzheimer’s disease research and clinical practice, and we analyze the implications of our results for early detection and therapeutic possibilities. This paper contributes a large quantity of information to the growing corpus in the realm of Alzheimer’s disease prediction. It illustrates the advantages of data-driven methods and the importance of applying powerful machine learning algorithms in order to enhance healthcare results.

articleTitle: Enhancing Small and Medium OEMs’ Adoption of IIoT Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Small and Medium Original Equipment Manufacturers (SME OEMs) face challenges of high initial costs, lack of skilled workforce, data security concerns, and limited infrastructure for IIoT implementation. This research explores the crucial factors influencing the successful integration of Industry Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies into products and processes of SME OEMs. The study investigates the impact of IIOT Manufacturers’ operational and business support, training effectiveness, and awareness of benefits on SME OEMs’ adoption intention of IIoT solutions. A survey was conducted among 263 firms operating in 103 different equipment manufacturing operations across 67 cities, representing 11 industry sectors. The participants were SME OEMs, and data were collected to assess the influence of various factors on their willingness to adopt IIoT technologies. The study revealed significant insights into adopting IIoT solutions among SME OEMs. Training provided by IIoT manufacturers was found to have the most substantial impact on the adoption intention. Moreover, awareness of benefits and business and operational support had an equal and notable influence on the adoption intention of SME OEMs. These findings underline the importance of effective training programs and comprehensive support from IIoT manufacturers in facilitating successful IIoT integration. The study’s outcomes emphasize the value of fostering strategic partnerships between Small and Medium Original Equipment Manufacturers and Industry IoT Manufacturers. Such collaborations can be pivotal in enhancing IIoT adoption rates among SME OEMs, enabling them to stay competitive in the fast-paced market.

Author Keywords: Small and Medium Original Equipment Manufacturers (SME OEMs)

articleTitle: Prediction of Food Wastage using XG Boost
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This research study introduces a predictive modelling approach by employing machine learning algorithms to forecast food wastage levels, addressing significant challenges such as data variability, environmental dependencies, and socio-economic disparities. Recent techniques in food wastage prediction often struggle with integrating diverse datasets and achieving high predictive accuracy. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset featuring factors such as environmental conditions, socio-economic indicators, and historical wastage records, this study evaluates five prominent machine learning models: AdaBoost, XGBoost, CatBoost, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Gaussian Naϊve Bayes. The models were assessed using metrics including Mean Squared Error, Root Mean Squared Error, R-Squared Score, and Mean Absolute Error. XGBoost emerged as the top performer, demonstrating superior predictive accuracy and robustness despite the inherent challenges. Additionally, feature importance analysis was conducted to identify significant factors influencing food wastage, offering valuable insights for stakeholders and policymakers. This study underscores the potential of advanced machine learning techniques in addressing the complexities of food waste prediction and advancing sustainability within the food distribution network.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based CAD System for Multi-Class Lung Cancer Detection and Classification from Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the main causes of cancer-related fatalities worldwide, which underscores how crucial early and precise diagnosis procedures are to improve patient outcomes. The present diagnostic technologies have a variety of limitations, such as high false-positive rates, limited accuracy, and the requirement for professional interpretation. This study provides a state-of-the-art Computer-Aided Design (CAD) system that uses histopathology pictures to diagnose and categorize lung cancer using a mix of state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms. The performed analysis demonstrates the potential of deep learning-driven CAD systems to boost early diagnosis rates and assist pathologists by considerably enhancing lung cancer detection accuracy in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Enhanced logistics management through predictive modeling and analysis framework
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In response to the evolving needs of a well-named company, a logistics web application is developed that transcends the limitations of their existing static website. The objective of this work is to help the company in the industrial logistics market, modernize and improve its logistics operations. The suggested web application meets the various needs of clients, freight forwarders, and business proprietors. It includes three separate dashboards, each designed to meet the unique requirements of different stakeholders. A thorough visualization of customer information and analytics is possible through the owner’s dashboard, which offers deep insights into customer data. Customers and freight forwarders have more transparency and control over their logistics processes as they can track the real-time status of their shipments using BL numbers. Website visitors have the option to interact with an advanced in-built Chatbot, which provides a practical means of finding solutions to commonly requested queries. A smoothly integrated WhatsApp channel enhances this communication and allows users to explore the full range of services available in more detail. Modern technologies like Data science (DS) and machine learning (ML) are being incorporated into the system to improve its effectiveness and capacity for making decisions using visualization. This online application satisfies the diverse requirements of customers, commodities forwarders, and entrepreneurs. It comes with three distinct dashboards, which help to visualize customer information and analytics in great detail. With the ability to track the real-time status of their shipments, customers and freight forwarders can have greater transparency and control over their logistical processes. The ML model is incorporated by the owner to predict the Increase/Decrease in Import/Export based on each customer’s historical data. The accuracy obtained for this ML model is 84.27% for the Random Forest Classifier.

articleTitle: SentinelScan: Advanced Network Scanner and Packet Detection Suite
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In today’s interconnected digital landscape, safeguarding networked systems and preserving data integrity needs more attention. With the evolution of cybersecurity threats, the emergence of SentinelScan signifies a proactive response to these challenges. SentinelScan employs advanced packet manipulation techniques and realtime packet sniffing capabilities to offer a comprehensive defence against a wide spectrum of cyber threats. It integrates pivotal concepts in network security, including cryptographic algorithms, authentication mechanisms, secure communication protocols, and adherence to security standards. SentinelScan’s efficacy depends on the use of Scapy, a robust packet manipulation tool for enabling realtime packet sniffing. Customized Python scripts enable Scapy to intercept and analyze network packets, providing valuable insights into traffic patterns, protocol utilization, and potential security vulnerabilities. The proposed model comprises of various layers of the networking stack, including application layer protocols (client-server architecture, web, and email protocols) and transport layer protocols (UDP and TCP), detailing the connection establishment, reliable data transfer, and congestion control mechanisms. The proposed research methodology emphasizes precision, dependability, and reproducibility, ensuring rigorous environment configuration and documentation. These measures enhance the robustness of the findings, making SentinelScan an efficient tool for safeguarding digital assets.

articleTitle: A Review on Decoding Palm Leaf Manuscripts to Digital Information using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Ancient Tamil letters hold significant historical, archaeological, and linguistic value. This study explores various deep learning techniques employed to recognize handwritten Tamil characters in ancient palm leaf manuscripts. This study discusses about the five distinct layers of deep learning models: convolution, pooling, activation, fully connected, and softmax classifier. Further, this comprehensive study analyzes the morphological operations involved, feature processing, connected component analysis and compared the performance of various deep learning models such as MobileNet, ResNet and InceptionV3.

articleTitle: Integrating Multiple Recommendation Techniques for Enhanced Anime Discovery
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: Anime recommendation systems play a pivotal role in assisting users in discovering new content tailored to their preferences. This paper presents an innovative approach to anime recommendation utilizing content-based filtering techniques augmented by ensemble learning algorithms. The system leverages the TfIdfVectorizer to analyze textual data from anime names and ratings, extracting features to represent the content. Subsequently, ensemble learning algorithms including XGBoost, LightGBM, Gradient Boosting Decision Trees, AdaBoost, and CatBoost are employed to predict the accuracy of recommendations. The integration of content-based filtering and ensemble learning ensures a robust and accurate recommendation framework, enhancing user satisfaction and engagement. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in providing personalized anime recommendations, thereby facilitating users in exploring diverse and appealing content within the anime domain.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Automated Flour Recirculation and Dust Free Grain Grinding Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: The combination of two essential flour milling processes, Automatic Recirculation and Dust Free Grinding is examined in the project. By rerouting a portion of the output during times of low demand, the Automatic Recirculation System protects mill equipment from overheating and cavitation and guarantees the continuous operation of the machinery. The issues posed by airborne particles during the grinding process are addressed with the adoption of a Dust-free grinding system, which focuses on equipment design, ventilation, and filtration. In flour milling processes, efficiency, worker safety, and product quality are all improved by the synergistic integration of these systems. The prototype presents an integrated approach to flour milling process optimization in various industrial contexts by examining its fundamental concepts, design concerns, and possible advantages. To acquire the right consistency of the flour, people must repeatedly lift heavy weights of rice, wheat and other grains. They will have increased physical discomfort and muscular problems because of their frequent excessive weight-lifting during the grinding process, the formation of dusts causes severe breathing problems and maintenance are difficult during the process, the operator must push the grains manually into the next processing section. To overcome these problems Automated flour recirculation with a vacuum pump, ensuring grains are effortlessly transformed into the perfect powder form while minimizing manual effort and dust contamination. Inline vacuum transfer helps to reduce dust and the maintenance cost is low and easy to clean. Wiper is used to push the grains instead of a manual process. It reduces wastage of grains. Continuous monitoring will not be necessary.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Edge Computing: Emergence, Evolution, Challenges, Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: This study presents an overview of edge computing, including its history, development, problems, and strategies, in an easy-to-read manner. Conventional cloud computing is confronted with challenges such as security concerns and bandwidth congestion as smart devices become more prevalent. Edge computing has become a paradigm-shifting technology in response. This study describes how it evolved and sets itself apart from conventional models. Important issues in edge computing, like security and latency, are discussed, and simple but efficient solutions are suggested. In order to make edge computing more accessible to individuals looking for a brief introduction to this rapidly changing computing paradigm, this study attempts to provide a basic overview of the technology’s history, challenges encountered, and selected workable approaches.

articleTitle: Efficient Material Handling through Smart Hopper Level Monitoring and Conveyor Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Inventive Systems and Control (ICISC)
abstract: In the fly ash bricks manufacturing industry, effective management of raw materials is essential for both economic efficiency and environmental sustainability.
